age of accountability.explanation: Sia leh pha theih hun. Kum leh hun genna hi a, sia leh pha, a hoih leh a sia theih hun cihna hi. Hotkhiatna thu tawh kizom in naupang khat in sia leh pha a khentel theih ciangin mawhnei suak in, tua mawhna hangin Pasian tawh kikhen hi. Sia leh pha khentel theihma in naupangte in mawhna neilo hi. Hih pen Laisiangtho tawh kilehbulh hi. I nute gilsung pan i suahkhiatma nangawn in mawhneite ihi hi. Nute sung pan a mawhsa in kisuak a, mi khempeuh Pasian mai ah mawhcip in hotkhiatna ngahna ding bangmah sem theilo hi (Late 51:5; Rom 3:23; 6:23). Sia leh pha theihna tungtawn a tui kiphum zong om hi. Tuiphumna pen kum leh upatna tungah kingalo in pianthakna tungah kinga hi. Sia leh pha theih hun leh kumcin cianga tuiphumna zong phattuamna omlo hi.

Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui a kiphum masiah Pasian muhna ah tui kiphum nailo hi. Tuate in tuiphumna maan a neih ding kisam hi.

Sawltakte hun beita ahih manin Sawltakte tunga kipia Khasiangtho letsongte (spiritual gifts) zong beita hi. Pawlpi kiphuhna dinga Pasian piak Khasiangtho letsongte leh mi khempeuh tunga kipia Khasiangtho letsongte kilamdang hi. Sawltakte hun a Khasiangtho in na a sep leh nalamdang a bawl bangin tuni in thuzuite nuntakna ah nalamdang piang pahpah nawnlo hi. A hun kilamdang ahih manin nalamdang pianna zong kilamdang hi. arminianism.explanation: Arminius’ upna. Dutch mi James Arminius in (1560-1609) piangthakte upna ama ngaihsutna tawh kizui in hong gelhkhia hi. Ama thuhilhna a um leh a zuite Arminian kici a, ama upna leh hilhna khempeuh Arminianism kici hi. Arminius upna ah ei leh ei kihonkhia theilo hi, ahi zongin lungdamna thu um thei hi. Khasiangtho huhna tawh mawhnei khat in Pasian um thei hi, ci a, mawhcipna thu sang zolo hi. Mihingte hoihna paksak hi. Arminius upna ah Pasian in mi khat masuan ding theikhol a, tua theihkholhna tawh kizui in teel hi. Pasian in hotkhiatna thu a sang ding leh a um dingte theikhol ahih manin tuate bek teel hi. Arminius hilhna ah hotkhiatna leh kithoihna pen kiciangtan cihbang omlo in, mi khempeuh a dingin Zeisu si in, mihingte a dingin Zeisu si hi. Zeisu sihna leh thoihdamna pen a umte a dingin mannei hi. Upna pen eima khensatna tungah kinga a, mi khat in ama ut hun peuh ciangin Pasian thu um thei, piangthak thei hi. Arminius upna ah Pasian hehpihna kinial thei a, eima upnop hun ciangin Pasian thu ki-um thei leh kisang thei hi. Pasian hong tuampiak hehpihna om ahih manin gupna pen eima deih hun in kisang hi. Tua banah hotkhiatna ngahna dingin Pasian leh mihing kipawlna kisam hi. Mawhnei khat in hotkhiatna ngahna dinga Pasian sapna a zak hangin a deih keileh nial thei hi. Arminius upna ah hotkhiatna pen thuzuite cihtakna tungah kinga in, thuzuite i cihtak zawh laisiah hotkhiatna kitan theilo in, Pasian deihna i zuih zawhloh ciangin hotkhiatna kitankik hi. Mi khat pen Pasian hehpihna pan pialkhia a mawhna a bawl ciangin hotkhiatna zong mansuah thei hi.

athanasianism.explanation: Athanasius’ updan. Athanasius hilhna siksan in bishop of Alexandria in Council of Nicaea (325) bulphuh in Zeisu pen Pasian ahihna leh a om tawntung Pasian ahihna hong tangko in Arianism nuaisiah hi.

author of sin.explanation: Mawhna pankhia. Vantungmite sung pan Lucifer in Pasian dem nopna lungsim hong neih ciangin lei ah Pasian khiatsukna thuak in tua panin Satan hong piang hi. Satan pen langdo, do, susia cihna hi. Satan in Pasian gelna suksiat ding leh thuzuite nuntakna suksiat ding vaihawm tawntung hi. Mawhna pen Pasian thukham palsatna, Pasian thupiakte zuih lohna, Pasian thu manlohna leh eima ut banga gamtatna hi in, Pasian pen mawhna pankhiapa leh mawhna a piangsakpa hilo hi. Satan in mawhna piangsak hi. Satan in Pasian kammal laih hi. Satan in zuauna leh mawhna hong lutpih hi. Mihingte sungah mawhna a pankhia pen Pasian leh Adam hilo in Satan hi. Tua ahih manin a huathuai pen Satan hi.

authority of scripture.explanation: Laisiangtho thuneihna. Thuzuite tunga Laisiangtho thuneihna pen Pasian thupina tungah kinga hi. Pasian in thupina tawh kidim in, siangtho in thutak a, mawhna neilo ahih manin a kammal sungah zong mawhna leh khialhna omlo hi. Tua ahih manin thuzuite hong makaih dingin Laisiangtho bek kilawm leh kicing hi. Laisiangtho pen saptuam lutang hi. Pasian simloh Laisiangtho tungah kuamah omlo hi. Pasian simloh Laisiangtho sanga zalian zaw leh thupi zaw kuamah omlo hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian humopna tawh kigelh ahih manin khialhna omlo hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian in eite tungah thu hong genna leh hong kilaakna a nunung bel hi in, mundang ah Pasian aw zakna ding om nawnlo hi. Laisiangtho cihna banga nuntak ding hi. Upna leh hilhna khempeuh Laisiangtho tawh khinkhai ding leh tehkak ding hi. Gam thukhun, pawlpi thukhun leh mihingte pianpih ngeina tuamtuam sangin Pasian kammal vanglian zaw leh thupi zaw ahih manin Pasian kammal kimakaihsak ding hi. Leitung ah a thupi pen Laisiangtho bek om hi (2Tim.3:16-17).

baptism for the dead.explanation: Misite a dinga tui kiphumna. A sisa mi khat a dinga a damlai khat tui kiphumna hi. Hih pen Marcionte, Novatiante leh Mormonte sungah kizang hi.

baptism in jesus’ name.explanation: Zeisu min tawh tuiphumna. Zeisu in vantung ah a kahtoh ding ciangin a nungzuite tungah vak kawikawi unla mi khempeuh ka nungzui na suahsakkhit uh ciangin Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui na phum un, ci hi (Mt.28:19). Hih in tuiphum zia ding sawlna masa pen hi. Luka in Sawltak sungah Sawltakte nasep a gelhkik ciangin Zeisu min tawh tui kiphum ding Piter thuhilhna hong gen hi (Sawl.2:38). United Pentecostal Church (UPC) in hih mun siksan in tuiphumna ah ‘Zeisu min bek tawh’ tuiphum hi. Tuiphum pawlpi leh AG huam sunga omte in Zeisu hong sawlna bangin Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphum hi. Paul in tuiphumna khat bek om hi, ci hi (Efe.4:5). Pasian kammalte kitukkalh ngeilo ding ahih manin Zeisu min tawh tui kiphumna leh Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphumna zong a kilehbulh hilo ding hi, cih theihhuai hi. Sawltakte in Zeisu sawlna bangin sem dinga, Zeisu thupiak tawh a kilehbulh in gamta lo ding hi, cih uphuai hi.

baptism in the name of the father, son a.headword: baptism in the name of the father, son and spirit
translations: Baptism in the Name of the Father, Son and Spirit
baptism in the name of the father, son a.explanation: Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphumna. Zeisu in tuiphumna thupi ngaihsut ahih manin amah zong Johan tungtawn in Jordan gun ah hong kiphum hi. Tuiphumna in Pasian ka um hi, Pasian ta ka suakzo hi, si leng vantung gam ka tung ding hi, sihnung cianga tunna ding khamuanna ka ngah hi, ci a upna pulakna hi a, hotkhiatna ngahna ding hilo hi. Tuiphumna pen kumcin teh neih ding zong hilo a, upna tawh sepna hi. Tuiphumna pen Zeisu in saptuam tungah zuih ding thunih hong piakte sungah a masa pen hi in, a khat pen nekkhawm hi. Zeisu in vantung ah a kahtoh ding ciangin nungzuite tungah Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphum ding sawl hi (Mt.28:19).

baptism in water.explanation: Tui sungah phumna. Tui sungah phumna leh diahna hi. Zeisu in mi khat a pianthak leh tui kiphum ding hong sawl hi. Tuiphumna pen thehna leh leihna hilo in pumpi bup tui sungah diahna hi. Pumpi bup kawt ding hi (Mt.28:19). Tuiphumna in kipumkhatna hi. Zeisu zong tui kiphum hi. Pasian thu a umte tui a kiphum dingin hong sawl hi.

baptism of believers.explanation: Pasian thu a umte tui kiphumna. Tuiphumna in Pasian ta suahna hilo in thuzuite tawh kipumkhatna hi. Tuiphumna in upna lahna hi. Thukhun Lui sungah Judah mite sunga pasalno khempeuh vun ki-at hi. Thukhun Thak ah Pasian thu a umte bek tui kiphum hi. Pianthakna pen tuiphumna in zui hi. Pentecost Ni in Jerusalem ah mi 3000 piangthak in, tui kiphum pah uhhi. A piangthakte bek tui kiphum hi.

baptism of blood, the.explanation: Kithahna sisan in tuiphumna. Pasian min tawh bawlsiatna thuakna tawh thahna tungtawn a luangkhia sisan in tuiphumna tawh kibang hi. Upna hanga thahna thuakte sisan in tui a kiphum nai keileh ama a dingin tua sisan in tuiphumna hipah hi.

baptism of desire.explanation: Tui kiphum nopna. RC sunga Pasian thuthuk a kan pawlkhat in tui kiphum nopna in tuiphumna tawh kikim hi, ci hi. Tua banga Pasian thuthuk duhna leh deihna pen tuiphumna zahin thupi hi, ci hi.

baptism of jesus.explanation: Zeisu tui kiphumna. Nasep a kipat ding ciangin Zeisu in Jordan gun ah Johan tungtawn in tui kiphum hi (Mt.3:16-17; Mk.1:9-11; Lk.3:21-22). Khazih tui kiphumna sungah Pa Pasian omna leh Khasiangtho omna kilang a, Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ahi Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho omna nial theih hilo hi. Khazih tui kiphumna in tapidaw upna laigil bel hong lah bangin thuzuite tui kiphumna in hih upna thukpi mah kilangsak hi. Pianthakna pen Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho Pasian khat nasep hi.

baptism of the spirit.explanation: Khalam tuiphumna. Tapidawte sungah khalam tuiphumna updan nam nih om hi. Tuiphumna pen pumkhat suahna hi. Khasiangtho in Pasian tawh pumkhat hong suaksak hi. Khasiangtho in mihingte lungsim ah upna hong guat ciangin Pasian tawh pumkhat hong suaksak bek thamlo in a piangthak khempeuh tawh zong pumkhat hong suaksak hi. Khasiangtho tuiphumna pen pianthakna hi a, pianthak khit ciangin Khasiangtho khuanung tun cihna hilo hi. Piangthakte sungah Khasiangtho in tenden hi. Pentecostal leh Charismaticte in Khalam tuiphumna pen Khasiangtho in Pasian tawh pumkhat hong suahsakna, pianthakna, upna tawh dikna ngahna ahihna umlo in, Khalam tuiphumna pen pianthak zawh hun khat cianga hong khuanung tun hi, ci hi. Khalam tuiphumna pen kamtuam pauna tawh kilangkhia a, Pentecost hun mah bangin tuni dongin Khasiangtho nasepna kizomlai hi, ci uhhi.

baptism, adult.explanation: Uliante bek tuiphumna. Tapidawte sungah tuiphumna thu ngaihsutna kilamdang hi. Naungekte nangawn tuisawp in, tuitheh in, tuileih in Pasian mi suakta hi a ci zong om hi. Tuiphumna pen sia leh pha khentel thei a mimal upna a pulak theite a ding bek hi. Thukhun Thak tui kiphumna ah upna om masa hi. Thukhun Thak ah Pasian thu a umte bek tui kiphum hi.

baptism, believers’.explanation: A umte tui kiphumna. Kam tawh upna pulakte bek tuiphumna hi. Thukhun Thak ah Pasian ka um hi a cite bek tui kiphum hi. Tuiphum pawlpi in upna neite bek tuiphum hi.

baptism, faith.explanation: Upkhit teh tuiphumna. Thukhun Thak ah mi khat a pianthak ciangin tui kiphum hi. Pentecost Ni in mi 3000 piangthak in tui kiphum uhhi. Kumcin cianga tuiphumna omlo in pianthak zawh cianga tuiphumna bek kimu hi. A piangthakte bek tui kiphum ding hi.

baptism, john’s.explanation: Johan tuiphumna. Tuiphumpa Johan in Jordan gun sungah Zeisu nasep a kipat ding ciangin tui na phum hi (Mt.3:1-12).

baptism, lay.explanation: Mi mawkmawkte tuiphumna. Pawlpi leh kipawlna pan theihpihna ngahlo a mi mawkmawk khat in midangte tui a phumna hi.

baptism, mode of.explanation: Tuiphum zia. Zeisu in nungzuite tungah ama thu a umte tuiphum ding vaikhak banah Zeisu mahmah tui kiphum hi. Ahi zongin tulai thuzuite sungah tuiphum zia a tuamtuam om hi.

baptismal.explanation: tuiphumna  kituiphumna  tui kiphuumna  Christian biakna sungah a luut nuamte’n a luut nading pawlpite ciin danin tui kiphuumna nei masa-in, tua zawh ciangin pawlpi mi picing khat suak thei pan hi Baptism cih pen tui sungah phuum mang suk cihna hi

baptismal formula.explanation: Tui kiphumte zuih ding. Tuiphumna pen pelh theih hilo hi. Tui kiphum ciangin Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian min lawh ding hi. Tui kiphum ciangin Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kong phum hi, cih tektek ding hi.

baptismal regeneration.explanation: Tuiphumna tawh pianthakna. Tuiphumna tawh pianthakna kingah in Pasian ta kisuak hi, cihna hi a, piangthakte in hih bangin sanglo hi. Piangthakte in up khitteh tuiphumna in zui cih pom gige hi. Ahang in, tuiphumna in hotkhiatna ngahna ding hilo in, hotkhiatna leh khamuanna ngahna thu lahkhiatna hi.

baptismal renewal.explanation: Hong thaksuaksak tuiphumna. Naungek lai a tui kiphum, kitheh khin a, gol cianga tui kiphumkikna in hong nosuaksak hi. Tua banah gol cianga tui kiphumna in i lungsim hong nosuaksak hi.

baptismal service.explanation: Tuiphum hun. Tui kiphumna in biakpiakna mah hi in, phatna leh biakna kinei hi.

baptismal vows.explanation: Kiciamna. Naungekte tui kitheh ding cianga nu leh pate kiciamna leh a golte tui kiphum ding cianga Pasian mai ah siapa tungtawn a kiciamna hi.

baptist briders.explanation: Khazih mo tuiphumte. Landmark Tuiphum Pawlpi upna ah saptuam pen Khazih mo kici ahih manin pianthak khit cianga upna tawh Tuiphum Pawlpi sungah tuiphumna a ngahte in Khazih mo tui kiphumte cihna ngah hi. Tui kiphumte in Khazih sawlna mang ahih manin Vantung a tun ciangin Khazih mo hihna thupha sang ding hi.

baptist distincitves.explanation: Tuiphum pawlpi upna laigilte. Tuiphum Pawlpi in Laisiangtho thuneihna, Saptuam suahtakna, Siampi za ngahna, Thupiak nih: tuiphumna leh nekkhawm, Mimal upna leh pianthakna, Piangthakte bek pawlpi mi a sanna leh pan mun nih: pastor leh a huh, cihte um hi. Tuiphum pawlpi in hun khenna 7 um ahih manin Israel leh saptuam kilamdanna, kumpite leh saptuam kikhenna leh meitung pan misiangthote a la dinga Zeisu hong paina dingte um in hilhkik uhhi.

baptist successionism.explanation: Tuiphumte goluahna. Landmaker kici Tuiphum pawlpi upna leh hilhna ah tuiphumna pen John a kipan tuni dong kizom ahih manin Tuiphum Pawlpi in John tungtawn in tuiphumna thupha, go thupha, kiluahsuk hi. Tuiphum pawlpi sungah om a tui kiphumna bek a maan pen tuiphumna in ngaihsun hi.

baptist tradition, the.explanation: Tuiphum pawlpi dinmun. Tuiphum pawlpi in Pasian thu a umte bek tuiphum in, Laisiangtho thuneihna tungah kinga in, suaktatak a Pasian biak ding thupisak in, ngaihsutna zong thupisak in, a piangthakte bek tuiphum in pumpi bup tui sungah diahsuk hi.

Tuiphum Pawlpi upna paipi in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian, Zeisu in Pasian leh mihing ahihna, Khasiangtho in Pasian leh mi ahihna, Laisiangtho in Pasian humop ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo in a nunung pen Pasian kilaakna, Mi khempeuh Pasian mai ah mawhcip in Zeisu in mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak in, a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah a, upna hangin hehpihna tawh Pasian mai ah dikna kingah a, Saptuam a la dingin leitung ah Zeisu in meitung tuangin hong paikik ding, Zeisu in saptuam lutang, Gimna lianpi a tunma in laktohna om dinga, Kum 1000 maanna a tunma in Zeisu a Nihveina hong paikik ding, cihte hi.

Laisiangtho simna tungtawn a tha i ngah leh tua mun pen Pasian kammal suak hi. Laisiangtho pen kilaakna tetti hi. Ama upna ah Laisiangtho pen khial thei hi. bible, holy.explanation: Laisiangtho. Laisiangtho in Pasian kammal leh Pasian thubu hi. Laisiangtho pen khenpi nih kisuah a, khat pen Thukhun Lui hi in, bu 39 om a, a dang khat pen Thukhun Thak kici in bu 27 om hi. A vekpi in bu 66 om hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian humopna leh makaihna tawh kigelh ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo in, a vekpi in siangtho hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian in thuzuite tungah hong kilaakna leh thu hong genna hi. Tapidawte tunga thunei pen Laisiangtho hi.

biblical christianity.explanation: Laisiangtho tawh kituak tapidaw updan. Laisiangtho tawh kituak tapidaw updan leh nuntakna in Pasian tungah thumaanna leh cihtakna hi. Laisiangtho tawh kituaklo updan leh kalsuan dan thuzuite sungah tampi kimu hi. Laisiangtho in tapidaw upna bulpi ahih manin Laisiangtho pualam ah theihna maan ngahna ding omlo hi. Laisiangtho hilhna banga nuntakna leh sepna in tapidaw maan hihna hi.

biblical criticism.explanation: Laisiangtho kantelna. Laisiangtho bute pen Pasian in mihingte zanga hong gelhkhiat ahih hangin mihingte mawhna leh khialh theihna huhau in Laisiangtho bu pawl khat pen khial thei ding hi, khialhna om ding hi cih uplahna om hi. Hih pen kum zalom 17 kim a piang upna khat hi. Thukham laibu ahi Piancilna pan Thuhilhkikna pen Moses gelh ahihna leh ahih lohna kibuaipih hi. Moses gelh ahihna um phalo hi.

biblical realism.explanation: Thu nih gawmkhop. Laisiangtho thuthukte theihna dinga leitung nate leh Laisiangtho thute mah gawmkhawm a kankhopna hi.

biblical theology.explanation: Thukhun Lui leh Thak omzia sutna. Thukhun Lui leh Thukhun Thak a huamkim a etna leh sinna hi a, a kigelh masakna Hebru leh Greek laite a kipan limtak in kankhia a, Pasian kammal deihna banga sutna hi. Thukhun Lui leh Thak omzia limtak a kantelna leh hilhna hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho tawh hong kilaak in thu hong gen a, Pasian kammal limtak a sutna leh zuihna hi. Thukhun Lui ah Eden huan a kipan Pasian leh mite kizopna, Noah hun a Pasian leh mite kizopna, Tanglai misiangthote kalsuan zia, Abraham leh Pasian kizopna, Moses hun, Saul a kipan kumpi tuamtuamte in Israelte a uk hun, kamsangte tawh Pasian nasepna cihte kimu hi. Thukhun Thak sungah lungdamna thu bu 4 kigelh a, tuate sungah a masa 3te in Zeisu thu a muhzia kibang in mihing khat bangin gelh uhhi. Mattiu in Zeisu pen Kumpi bangin gen a, Marka in Zeisu pen Mite Nasem bangin gen a, Luka in Zeisu pen Mihing Tapa bangin gen hi. Lungdamna thu bu 4na in Zeisu pen mihing hihna bek hilo in Pasian tapa leh Pasian pianngei a dim a nei ahihna gen hi. Zeisu pen Pasian hi in, na khempeuh thei hi. Lungdamna Johan in Zeisu pen Pasian leh Pasian Tapa ahihna hong hilh hi. Tangthu bu khat om a tua pen Khasiangtho in Sawltakte zanga na a sepna leh saptuam kipatna hi. Saptuam pen Khasiangtho nasepna tawh kipan hi. Jeim pen Zeisu sanggampa hi. Thukhun Lui mah bangin Pasian thu zuihna leh thumanna limgen hi. Jeim in bawlsiatna a thuak Judahte tungah gelh hi. Upna tawh nuntakna leh sepna limgen hi. Hotkhiatna sangin gamtatna uanggen zaw hi. Na hoih sepna in hotkhiatna i ngahlam kitelsak hi. Paul in Thukhun Thak sungah tam a gelh pen bek hilo in Laisiangtho buppi sungah tam a gelhpen pa hi. Rom a kipan Filemon dong (bu 13) Paul in gelh a, pianthakna mah bulphuh pen hi. Hebru pen a gelh kitello in Paul gelh hi a ci zong om a, Apollos gelh hi ding hi, a ci zong om hi. Hebru sungah Thukhun Lui sunga mite biakpiakna leh ngeina tampi kimukik ahih manin Judahte ngeina a thei mahmah khat in gelh hi ding cih kimu hi. Hebru in Zeisu thu, Zeisu thuakna, hotkhiatna leh sianthona limgen hi. Piter, Juda leh Johan in amau veina bangin laikhak gelh uhhi. Johan in mailam thu ding limgen a, Kilaakna sungah i tel zawhloh thuthuk tampi om hi. Thukhun Lui leh Thak in Pasian humopna tawh kigelh ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo in, a vekpi in Pasian kammal hi. Pasian in a khial theilo ama kammal tawh eite tungah thu hong gen hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian hong kilaakna hi.

biblicism.explanation: Laisiangtho kipletna. Tapidawte sungah Pasian kammal upzia leh hilhzia a tuamtuam a om manin Laisiangtho omzia kantelna kinei a tua panin Laisiangtho tungah kiptak a dinna leh Laisiangtho pen khial theilo hi cih kipletna piang hi.

biblicity.explanation: Laisiangtho banga nuntakna. Laisiangtho hilhna banga gamtatna leh hilhna in Pasian zahtakna leh thumaanna hi. Mawhna pelh a Pasian deihna zuihna leh Pasian kammal bulphuhna in Khazih sutna hi.

charismaticism.explanation: Khasiangtho letsongte bek deihna. A omsa tapidawte sung pan AD 1906 in Azusa Street, USA ah khanlawhna thak, Pentecostalism, piangkhia in hih tawh kizom toto in Charismatic upna hong khuanung pian hi. Khasiangtho letsongte bek ultungsak a, tua pen nisim tuahkhak thute tawh kizomsak in, Pa leh Tapa nasepna hemkhia in Khasiangtho nasep bek thupisak hi. Sawltakte hun mah bangin tuni dongin Khasiangtho letsongte kizom paisuak a, biakpiakna leh upna tawh kalsuanna ah Khasiangtho letsongte kilangkhia hamtang ding hi, ci in 1 Korin 12 leh 14 siksan hi. Khasiangtho letsong bek a thupi ngaihsutte Charismatic believers kici hi. Hih bang upna neite in Pasian kammal thupina donlo in mihingte tuahkhak thupisak zaw hi. Hotkhiatna pen Zeisu upna tawh kingah hi, ci napi Khasiangtho tuiphumna, baptism of the Spirit, pen pianthakna, Khasiangtho in Pasian tawh hong gawmna umlo leuleu hi. Pentecostal leh Charismatic (a tom in AG) a kicite in pianthakna pen Khasiangtho ngahna in ngaihsun lo in pianthak zawh hun khat teh Khasiangtho hong khuanung tun hi, ci hi. Tua Khasiangtho ngahna pen kamtuam pau tawh kilang ding hi. Sawltakte hun mah bangin nalamdang tuamtuam in zui ding hi. Hih thu ah piangthakte khen nih kisuah hi.

charismatics.explanation: Khasiangtho letsong ultungsakte. Mi khat sungah Khasiangtho lut a mun a ngah leh Kha in a khel ciangin pianthakna kipan hi. Pianthakna in Kha nasep hi. A piangthak khempeuh tungah Khasiangtho letsong a tawm pen khatciat hong kipia hi. Ahi zongin tapidawte sungah pawl khat in Pa leh Tapa a kipan Laisiangtho thupina hemkhia in Khasiangtho leh a letsongte bek thupisak in kamtuam pauna bek lim ngaihsut hi.

christ, benefits of.explanation: Khazih tung pan thuphate. Zeisu in leitung ah mihing hong suahna, a sihna, thawhkikna leh van ah a kahna tungtawn in thuzuite in kha thupha tampi kisang hi. Zeisu upna bek tawh hih kha thuphate kingah hi.

christ, imitation of.explanation: Khazih etteh ding. A piangthak khat in Zeisu hilhna banga nisim nuntak ding leh sianthona tawh nungta dinga ki-apna hi. Zeisu etteh a nuntak ding hi.

christian beliefs.explanation: Thuzuite upna. Thuzuite upna in bulkip a nei upna hi a, tua in Zeisu tungah kilam in, tu in Laisiangtho tawh kimukhia hi. Ahi zongin thuzuite sungah updan leh hilhdan kilamdang tampi om hi.

christian doctrines.explanation: Thuzuite upna zungpite. Laisiangtho siksan in tanglai misiangthote in tapidaw upna zungpite kalkhia a, eite kithuhilhna suak hi. Pasian leh Laisiangtho in tapidaw upna bulpi hi.

christian feminism.explanation: Tapidawte sunga numeite thu. Tapidawte sungah numeite siampi za piakna, pawlpi sungah panmun thupi neihna leh thuhilhna vai ah ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Numeite leh pasal kikimna, nenniamna pan suahtakna ding cihte ah numeite dinmun kithusimlo hi. Numeite zong mihing mah hi.

christian theology.explanation: Tapidaw upna paipi. Leitung a biakna khempeuh in upna paipi a neih bangin tapidawte in zong upna paipi nei hi. Tapidaw upna paipi pen Laisiangtho hi. Tapidaw upna in mihingte patkhiat hilo in Pasian patkhiat ahih manin Pasian thu kithupi ngaihsut hi. Pasian khat bek omna kipom in, mihingte mawhcipna zong kilenkip in, Zeisu in mawhneite hong hotkhiatna zong thupi mahmah in, Pasian thu a umte in vantung gam tung ding, Pasian in Laisiangtho tawh thuzuite hong sapna leh hong hopihna banah hun khat ciangin Zeisu pen saptuam a la dingin hong paikik ding hi. Biakna dangte leh tapidaw upna sungah kibatna omlo hi.

christianity and culture.explanation: Tapidaw upna leh ngeina. Upna leh ngeina kizopna ah ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Tapidaw upna in Pasian kammal tawh piangkhia a, ngeina in mihingte tung pan piangkhia hi. Pasian kammal kikhel theilo in mihingte ngeina a mun leh a hunzui in kikhel hi.

christlikeness.explanation: Khazih sutna. Khazih sutna in tapidawte dinmun sang pen hi. Muhna, ngaihsutna genkhiatna leh sepna ah Zeisu etteh ding hi. Zeisu in kiniamkhiatna tawh nungta hi. Zeisu in mawhneite it hi. Zeisu in midangte hehpih hi. Zeisu in genthei liangvaite hehpih hi. Zeisu in a galte mawhna maisak hi. Zeisu in sih dongin citak hi. Hih bang lungsim a neite thupha ngah hi.

christmas tree.explanation: Christmas kung. AD 700 kiim-in Germante a piangthak sak Saint Boniface in mangtaak kung pen Christiante kiciapteh nadingin nazang hi. Kum zalom 11 ciangin tua singkung pen Pazadih ciaptehna lim hong suak aa, apple pumsante tawh ki puahhi. Martin Luther hong khan ciangin tua singkung namte inn sungah koihin meivak tawh napuah hi. Tua hun panin Germany-ah mangtaak kung namte Christmas hun ciangin kizem hi. German mite in leitung mun tuamtuam ah hih amau ngeina hong puak kawikawi uh-a tu-in leitung bup in zatpih ta hi hang (Yashoda, 2018).

christocentric.explanation: Khazih bulphuh. Singkhuam tunga Zeisu sihna in hotkhiatna bulpi hi. Zeisu sihna a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi. Vantung gam tunna dingin lampi tuamtuam omlo in, Zeisu bek vantung lampi hi. Khazih sunga omte in mithak hi. Zeisu tunga kinga upna leh lametna bek kip hi. Zeisu leh Laisiangtho bek bulphuhna in tapidaw hoih nuntakna hi. Khazih tunga kilamlo upna in a si hi. Khazih upna bek tawh Pasian ta kisuak banah nisim in lungnopna kingah hi.

christocentrism.explanation: Khazih tungah kilamna. Tapidawte upna bulpi in Khazih leh a thuhilhna tungah kilam hi. Tapidawte in Khazih nungzuite hi. Khazih in upna a piangsakpa leh a kicingsakpa hi (Heb.12:1-2). Tapidaw upna in leitung a biaknate tawh kibanglo in, Pasian patkhiat hi in, Zeisu in pawlpi phut hi. Piter tungah pawlpi kiphut lo hi.

christology.explanation: Khazih thu sutna. Zeisu pen Pasian leh mihing hi. Mihing khat tungah hih pianngei nih omkhawm hi. Pasian ahihna leh mihing ahihna tawh hong sepsak khempeuh sutna hi. Khazih in mawhneite a dingin sih dongin thumaan in nasem hi.

christology from above.explanation: Khazih Pasian ahihna. Zeisu pen a om tawntung Pasian hi in, Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a nihnapa hi. Pasian ahihna genna hi (Jn.1:1).

christology from below.explanation: Khazih mihing hihna. Zeisu in mawhneite honkhia dinga hong pai ahih manin leitung ah a om sungin mihing hihna a dim in nei hi. Zeisu pen Pasian bek hilo in mihing hihna a dim in nei hi.

christomonism.explanation: Khazih bek bulphuhna. Pasian thu sutna leh tapidaw upna thu sutna ah Zeisu bek bulphuh a genna leh gupna thu zong Zeisu tung pan hong pai hi. Zeisu bek lampi ahihna ultunsakna hi. Zeisu simloh hong honkhia thei kuamah omlo hi.

christomorphic.explanation: Khazih etteh. Khazih sun a nuntakna leh Khazih bek ettehna hi.

christotokos.explanation: Khazih paai. Nestorius in Mary thu a genna ah hih kammal zanga, Mary pen Zeisu nu hi in, a gilsung ah Khazih paai hi, ci hi. Theotokos pen Mary in a gilsung ah ‘Pasian paai hi’ cihna hi.

christus victor.explanation: Mawhneite tanga Zeisu thuakna. Zeisu sihna leh thuakna in mawhna vangliatna leh dawi vangliatna khempeuh zo hi. Sihna pen mihingte gal hi in, mi khempeuh in kihta hi. Ahi zongin Zeisu in sihna, mawhna, ze-etna leh gentheihna zo hi. Ahi zongin tapidawte in Zeisu zawh khempeuh kizolo hi. Zeisu in Sawltakte tungah vangliatna pia napi tua vangliatna mun khempeuh ah zang theilo in, nalamdang a pian lohna mun tampi om hi. Zeisu in a gualzo penpa hi.

church authority.explanation: Pawlpi thuneihna. RC upna ah thuneihna khempeuh pawlpi tungah om hi. Langpangte upna ah Laisiangtho tung bek ah thuneihna om hi.

church discipline.explanation: Pawlpi kalsuanna. Pawlpi sunga Pasian a zahtaklote thuhilhna leh vauna hi. Thuhilhna ah kal 4 om a, mimal a kimuhpihna leh vauna; nih leh thum in kimuhpih a hilhna leh vauna; pawlpi mibup in hilhna leh vauna leh pawlpi mi hihna pan hawlkhiatna leh tawpsakna hi (Mt.18:15-20). Kisikkikna a om ciangin kilamthakna leh kipuahphatna piang hi. Pawlpi thuhilhna deihna pen mailam ah i tuah ding Pasian thuhilhna pan suahtakna ding hi. Pasian in mihingte hong it hangin mawhna mudah ahih manin thukhen banah thuhilhna in zuilai hi. Pawlpi sung kithuhilhna pen Pasian minthanna ding leh Khazih min tawisanna hi.

church growth.explanation: Saptuam khanna. Pentecost Ni in Jerusalem ah saptuam kipan a, nisim in thuzui kibehlap hi. Saptuam pen Pasian in a khangto dingin deih hi. Mimal khanna, lungsim khanna, sepna leh itna ah khanna kisam hi. Thungetna leh lungdamna thu genkhiatna bek tawh saptuam khang hi. Saptuam khanna dingin piakkhiatna, sum leh pai, tawh a sem ding, thungetna tawh a sem ding leh a kuankhia ding kisam, trinity of the church, hi. Lungdamna thu a genlo pawlpi in a si hi. A cidamlo pawlpi khang theilo hi.

church history.explanation: Saptuam tangthu. Zeisu in saptuam pankhia a, mihingte in Zeisu hilhna bangin kikalsuan in, Pasian deihna tawh a kinaih pen dingin kinungta hi. Pasian thuthuk theihna kiciangtan ahih manin a hunhun in thuzuite sungah upna leh hilhna maanlo piang hi. Saptuam tangthu in thuzuite nuntak zia hi.

church planting.explanation: Saptuam phuhna. Zeisu in vantung ah a kahtoh ding ciangin nungzuite tungah lungdamna thu tangko kawikawi un, ci hi. Zeisu in mun tuamtuam ah saptuam phuh ding leh khuavak tansak ding deih hi. Sawltakte hun leh Paul hong khan ciangin mun tuamtuam ah saptuam kiphut hi. Thuzuite nasep a thupi pen saptuam phuhna hi. Nungzuite in amau nopsakna mun nusia in leitung gam tuamtuam ah pai in vantung gam thu gen uhhi.

church-goer.explanation: Kilawmsakna tawh biakinn pai. Tapidaw kici napi pianthakna kician neilo, Pasian itna lah tello, piakkhiatna lah donlo, thunget lasak leh tetti pan ding zong utlo, Pasian nasepna ah zong lawpna mel neilo a Nipi ni biakinn tun ding a hanciamte hi. Tapidaw hoihlote omzia hi.

church’s image.explanation: Tapidawte dinmun. Laisiangtho sungah tapidawte dinmun lahna dinga kizang kammal tampi om hi. (1) Thuzuite in Pasian mite hi (Pai.6:7; Gal.6:16). (2) Khazih pumpi hi (Jn.15:5; Kol.3:4). (3) Khazih mo hi in, hun khat teh mopi dingin Khazih hong paikik ding hi (Jer.2:2; Klkna.19:7; 21:2). (4) Pasian innpi hi (Pai.25:8; Jn.4:23; 1Kor.3:16; Efe.2:22). (5) Pasian kumpi gam leh ukna hi (Late 114:2; Kol.1:13; Rom 14:17). (6) Pasian innkuanpih hi (Hos.1:1; Mt.2:15; Rom 8:14-17; Efe.2:19; 1Tim.3:15). (7). Pasian tuute hi (Late 80:1; 95:7; Jn.10:1-30; 1Pit.5:4; Jn.10:11; 21:17). (8). Pasian lenggah huan hi (Late 80:8; Is.5:1; Mk.12:1-12; Jn.15:1-8).

Pasian pen na khempeuh a hih thei, mun khempeuh a om leh na khempeuh a thei Pasian hi in, mihingte tungah hih pianngeite hong pialo hi. Ahi zongin ama pianngei mah ahi itna, ciimna, pilna, theihna, lainatna, sianthona, hoihna, cihtakna leh dikna cihte hong pia hi. council of chalcedon.explanation: Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 4 veina kimuhkhopna hi. Hih kimuhkhopna ah Zeisu pen Pasian hilo hi a ci Arius hilhna, Arianism, nial uhhi. Apollinarianism in Zeisu pen mihing taktak ahihna nial ahih manin hih kimuhkhopna ah nial leuleu hi. Nestorianism in Zeisu Pasian hihna leh mihing hihna khennih suah ahih manin hih kimuhkhopna ah nial leuleu hi. Eutychianism in Zeisu pianngei nam nih a kibang in gen leuleu ahih manin hih zong nial leuleu hi.

council of constance.explanation: Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 16 vei kimuhkhopna hi (1414-18). Hih kimuhkhopna ah John Wycliffe hilhna maanlo 45 kinial in, John Hus hilhna maanlo 30 zong kithalnial hi. Hih kimuhkhopna ah RC popete zong kihel ahih manin kithuhualna tawm ahih manin ahi milmial khat tawh dinkhawl uhhi.

council of constantinople (i,ii,iii).explanation: Kikhopna. Tapidaw masate nih veina, nga veina leh guk veina kimuhkhopna hi. Constantinople I (381) in Council of Nicea I (325) thukhenna kipsak in, Apollinarianism nial in, Khasiangtho pen Pasian ahihna kipsak uhhi. Constantinople II (553) in Origen leh Nestorius hilhna maanlo nial in Zeisu in Pasian hihna leh mihing hihna a neihna kipsak hi. Constantinople III (680-81) in Zeisu in Pasian hihna leh Pasian lungsim bek nei a, mihing lungsim neilo hi cihzong nial hi.

council of ephesus.explanation: Efesa ah kikhopna. Tapidaw masate a 3 vei (431) kimuhkhopna hi. Nestorius in Zeisu pen khat hilo in nih hi. Zeisu tungah Pasian hihna leh mihing hihna omlo in mi nih hi, ci ahih manin hih upna zong nial uhhi.

council of nicea (i,ii).explanation: Nicea ah kikhopna. Tapidaw masate khatveina leh sagih veina kimuhkhopna hi. Nicea I (325) in Zeisu pen Pasian hilo hi a ci Arius’ hilhna maanlo nial in, Zeisu pen Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah khat hi in, Pasian pianngei khempeuh nei in, Pasian ahihna kipsak hi.

council of trent.explanation: Kitukkalhna piang. Tapidaw masate 19 vei (1545-1563) kimuhkhopna hi. Hih hun in RC in thunei a, pianpih mawhna, dikkisakna, RC upna bulpi 7, nekkhawm, biakpiakna (RC missa), kha kholna (purgatory), kipsak in RC upna kip semsem hi. Hih kimuhkhopna ah Pawlpi kipuahphatna sunga kihelte leh hilhnate thalnial a, Pawlpi puahphate pen langdote, Protestants, ci uhhi. Langdote cih ciangin RC langdote cihna hi. Pawlpi kipuahphatna in RC langdona hilo in upna puahphatna hi.

council, general.explanation: Kikhopna tuamtuamte. A hunhun in mun tuamtuam ah tapidaw upna laigil tawh kilehbulh upna maanlo om ahih manin tuate dona ding leh hilhciatna dingin thuzui pawlkhat in kimuhkhopna nei in upna laigil kantel uhhi. Council of Nicea I (325) in Tapa pen Pasian ahihna kipsak in, Arianism pampaih hi. Council of Constantinople I (381) in Nicea kipsak banah Khasiangtho pen Pasian ahihna kipsak in, Apollinarianism pampaih hi. Council of Ephesus (431) in Zeisu tungah Pasian hihna leh mihing hihna a omkhopna kipsak in, Nestorianism pampaih hi. Council of Chalcedon (451) in Zeisu in pianngei nih a neihna kipsak in, Eutychianism pampaih hi. Council of Constantinople II (553) in Chalcedon upna pulakna kipsak in, Nestorianism leh Origenism pampaih hi. Council of Constantinople III (680-81) in Zeisu in ngaihsutna nam nih a neihna, Dyothelitism, kipsak in, lungsim khat bek leh ngaihsutna khat bek a neihna, Monothelitism, pampaih hi. Council of Nicea II (787) in milim zahtakna leh thupisakna piang hi.

covenant of grace.explanation: Hehpihna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, Pasian in mawhnei mihingte hong khualna leh hotkhiatna hi. Mihingte in mawhna sungah i puk ciangin Pasian in ama hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna lampi hong honsak hi. Kiciamna khempeuh Pasian in hehpihna tawh a sep hi a, tua pen hotkhiatna ngahna ding leh thuzuite in Pasian kihtakna tawh nisim kalsuan ding deihna hi. Pasian in Adam tawh kizopna ah hehpihna bulphuh in a sep bangbang hoihsa hi. Adam in Pasian deih bangin sem zolo ahih manin sihpih hi. Thukhun Lui sunga pasalnote zangmuk tanna leh Thukhun Thak a tuiphumna a kibang in ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih manin naupangte tungah Pasian hehpihna a dim in om hi. Naupangte in upna a neihloh hangin, sia leh pha a theihloh hangin, tuitheh leh tuileih ding hi, tua pen naupangte tungah Pasian kamciam a tunna hi.

covenant of redemption.explanation: Tatkhiatna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, hotkhiatna ngahna dingin Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah Tapa Zeisu in mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak hi. Pasian leh mite tawntung kiciamna sungah Tapa in mihing hong suak a, sepna tawh kiciamna nuai ah hong om in, mihingte tang dingin hong om a, ama luang kikham in mihingte mawh maina ding hong sepsak hi. Pa in Tapa leitung ah sawl hi. Tapa in mihing bangin hong suak in sihna hong thuak hi. Khasiangtho in mihingte lungsim ah upna guan hi.

covenant of works.explanation: Sepna tawh dikna. Reformed upna bulpi khat hi a, Pasian in Adam leh Eve tungah sepna leh thumanna tawh nuntak tawntungna ngahna ding leh thumanlohna in sihna piansak ding cihzong gen hi. Eden huan sunga singgah nek ding leh nek loh ding pen Pasian thumanna lahna hi a, thuman lohna pen sihna in zui ding hi. Thumanna in nuntakna hi. Adam leh Eve in Pasian thupiak zuilo ahih manin mawhna leh Pasian hehna pan suahtakna dingin hehpihna leh hotkhiatna kisam hi.

covenant people.explanation: Teeltuam mipawl. Pasian in Abraham suan leh khakte tungah thupha pia in, ka mite leh ka teeltuamte ci a, tua banah Zeisu upna hangin tapidawte zong Pasian teeltuamte leh Pasian mihonte sungah kihel hi. Thukhun Thak tapidawte zong upna hangin Abraham cikhah kisuak hi.

covenant relationship.explanation: A cituam kizopna. Pasian in ama thupiak a zuite tungah a cituam kizopna leh ciaptehna pia hi. Pasian thukham zuihna ah thupha om hi. Zeisu a umte in Pasian tawh a cituam kizopna nei hi. Mi khat a pianthak ciangin Pasian tawh kizopna bei thei nawnlo hi.

covenant renewal.explanation: A thaksuah kiciamna. Thuzuite in nisim in Pasian tawh kizopna thaksuahsak ding hi. Nekkhawm i zat ciangin Pasian tawh i kizopna thaksuak hi. Eite upna nisim in thaksuahsak ding hi.

covenant theology.explanation: Kiciamna paksakte upna. Kamciamna tunga kinga upna hi. Reformed upna laigil pen hi in, a kamciamte a tangtunna dinga Pasian nasepte kimu hi. (1) Mawhneite kihotkhiatna pen Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian in lung kihual in semkhawm hi. Zeisu in sihna tawh hong thoihdam in Pasian hehna damsak in hih thu a umte in mawh maina ngah in Pasian mai ah siangtho hi. (2) Sepna tawh kiciamna pen Adam leh Eve in thumanna hanga nuntakna a ngahna ding leh thuman lohna hanga a thuak ding sihna lak hi. (3) Hehpihna tawh kiciamna pen tanglai misiangtho ahi Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses leh David tungah Pasian in hehpihna tawh kizopna tuam a bawlna hi. Zeisu in ama sihna tawh mawhneite hong tankhia a, hehpihna bucing tawh hong kem hi. Mi khempeuh tungah hehpihna kicing ahih manin naupangte nangawn Pasian hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna sung tum uhhi.

Mipilte in Pasian piansaksa nate thu sut a, a piangsakpa a theih masiah theihna maan ngah theilo hi.

Pasian in Laisiangtho gelhte tungah a gelhsak thute deihna laigil theih ding deihna hi.

criticism, canonical.explanation: Laisiangtho sunga kihelte omzia sutna. Laisiangtho sunga kihel ding laibu leh laimalte omzia limtak in kikantel masa hi. Mun khat leh mun khat kizopna om dimdiam in kitukkalhna leh kilehbulh cihte omlo hi. Laisiangtho a simte in Laisiangtho kithuhualna mu ding hi. Pasian humopna tawh kigelh ahih manin kitukkalhna omlo hi.

criticism, comparative religions.explanation: Biakna leh tapidaw upna tehkakna. Leitung ah biakna lian 5 om hi. Amaute in tapidawte zong biakna sungah hong helnuam in hong zolzol hi. Tapidaw upna in biaknate tawh kibanglo hi. Tapidaw upna leh biakna tuamtuamte sunga kibatna leh kilamdanna tuamtuamte sutna leh tehkakna hi.

criticism, form (formgeschichte).explanation: Tangthu masa kanna. Laisiangtho thute kantelna ah a beisa thu leh a masalam thute kan masakna hi. Laimalte leh kammal omzia tawh kizui a thu omzia sutna hi. Mite nuntakna tawh kizui a Pasian thu kantelna in theihna maan pia thei hi (German: Sitz im Leben).

criticism, historical.explanation: Tangthu tawh kizui a kanna. Pasian kammalte sutna ah a sungthu bek hilo in tangthu omzia sutna zong kisam hi. Laisiangtho kigelh hun a mite ngeina, pau leh laite, mite gamtat dan a kipan thupiangte theihna in Pasian kammal omzia lak hi

criticism, literary-source.explanation: Laibu leh laimalte tungtawn a sutna. Pasian kammalte kantelna ah laibu omzia leh laimalte omzia enkawmsa a kanna in theihna maan piangsak hi. Laisiangtho tang khat i sim ciangin tua in bang gen a, bang deihna nei a, a khiatna bang hiam cih kan tawntung ding hi.

criticism, narrative.explanation: Tangthu paizia etna. Pasian kammal sungah tangthu paizia leh thu paiziate etna panin Pasian kammal ahihna kilang a, tua in thuthuk muhna khangsak hi. Laisiangtho gelhte in amau hun a tangthu leh thupiangte tawh kizui a hong gelh ciangin a deihna kitel banah Pasian kammal ahihna kitelsak hi.

criticism, redaction.explanation: Laibu enphate kipsakna. Laisiangtho thu kantelna ah laigelhte in a kipsakna tawh kizui a sanna leh upna hi. Laigelhte banah laibu enphate kipsakna in Pasian kammal ahihna leh hih lohna zong lak hi.

criticism, rhetorical.explanation: Kampau tawh sittelna. Mihingte zat kammalte leh paute tungtawn in Pasian kammal thupina leh upna laigil ahihna kimukhia hi. Laisiangtho sunga mite zat kammalte tungtawn in Pasian kammal ahihna zong kimukhia hi.

criticism, source.explanation: Kipatna zonna. Laisiangtho omzia sutna ah hih laibu leh hih sunga thute koi pan hong kipankhia hiam cih zonna hi. Pasian lahna tawh mite hong gelhkhiat ahih manin hih kammal leh laibute kipatna limtak a kan ding hi. Kipatna tawh kizui in JEDP cih Pasian min tuamtuam zong kimukhia hi. Hih pen Laisiangtho sunga a masa bu 5 sunga kimukhia hi. (J- Yahwist; E-Elohist; D-Deuteronomist; P-Priestly).

criticism, structural.explanation: Laibu omzia tawh etna. Laisiangtho omzia sutna ah kammal leh laibute omzia tawh kizui a kantelna hi. Laisimte in laibu omzia leh laimal luanzia zui in a deihna thei hi.

death of god theology.explanation: Pasian sihna. AD 1960 khitteh hong piang updan hi in, Nietzsche’ muhna tungtawn a piangkhia, ‘Pasian si hi’ ‘God is dead’ cih tawh kizom hi. Thomas J. J. Altizer (b.1927) muhna ah Pasian pen Khazih tungtawn a mihing hong suah ciangin Pasian ahihna beita hi. William Hamilton (b.1924) muhna ah tu hun mite in Pasian thu um zo nawnlo hi, ahang in, Zeisu hangin Pasian sikhinta a, saptuam in Pasian tawh kipawl nawnlo a sep ding hi. Hih upna pen hilhna maanlo hi. Ahang in, Pasian pen si ngeilo in nungta tawntung banah amah a umte zong nuntak tawntungna pia hi (Jn.3:36).

death, eternal.explanation: Tawntung sihna. Tawntung sihna in mawhna thamante lak ah khat hi. Mawhna hangin mihingte sungah Pasian thu a umlote in tawntung sihna thuak hi. Tawntung sihna pan hong honkhia dingin Zeisu hong pai hi. A umte in sihna pan suakta in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi.

death, first.explanation: Sih masakna. Pumpi sihna in hih leitung nuntakna pan tawpna leh khawlna hi. Hih pen sih masakna hi a, a nihvei sihna ahi Kha sihna, pianthak lohna hanga kha sihna tawh kilamdang hi.

death, physical.explanation: Pumpi sihna. Pumpi sihna in mawhna thamante lak ah khat hi in, a ngeina hilo ahih manin mi khempeuh in kihta hi. Mi khempeuh in pumpi sihna thuak ding hi. Ahi zongin, thuzuite sihna pen ihmutna hi. A ihmute khanglo in thokik ahih manin sihna pen ihmutna hi a, dah ding leh kihtak ding hilo hi. Sihna in tawmvei sung tawlngakna hi.

death, second.explanation: Nihvei sihna. Pasian in Zeisu tungtawn a hong piak nuntak tawntungna a ngahlo khempeuh nihvei si ding hi. Upna in nuntakna hi a, uplohna in sihna hi (Klkna.2:11; 20:6; 21:8).

death, spiritual.explanation: Kha sihna. Mawhna thamante sungah a kihtakhuai pen leh a dahhuai pen kha sihna hi. Pasian a umlo khempeuh leh a piangthak lo khempeuh khalam ah si hi. Pasian tawh a kikhente khalam ah si hi. Kha sihna a thuak peuhmah in tawntung sihna thuakpah ding hi. Kha sihna pan hong honkhia dingin Zeisu leitung ah hong pai in, mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak hi.

decrees of god.explanation: Pasian gelnate. Mihingte theihban loh leitung pianma pek a Pasian gelna hi. Pasian in na khempeuh thei ahih manin a piang ding khempeuh zong thei hi. Mawhna a pianna ding zong thei ahih manin hotkhiatna, numei Mary sung pan Zeisu hong suahna, Zeisu sihna leh thuakna, sihna pan thawhkikna leh hong paikikna ding dongin Pasian in gelsa in nei hi. Theihkholh loh a piang huihpi nunna, guahzukna, zinlinna, tuikhang leh mencim dongin Pasian in thei hi. Pasian in mite nuntakna susia nuamlo hi. Ahi zongin mawhna a muhdah hangin Pasian in mihingte it ahih manin lampi tuamtuam tawh thuzuite hong thuhilh hi. I thuak gimnate in Pasian thuhilhna zong hi thei hi. Pasian in na khempeuh gelsa in nei hi. Tua hi a, ama thu a piangtawm, mihingte bawltawm, cihte omlo hi.

decrees, eternal.explanation: Gelna. Pasian in na khempeuh a dingin gelna nei hi. Pasian gelna khempeuh a tawntung ding hi. Vantung in a tawntung ding ahih bangin gawtmun zong a tawntung ding hi.

depravity, total.explanation: Mawhcipna. Mihingte mawhcipna hi. Mawhna hangin mi khempeuh Pasian tawh kikhen in Pasian gal suak a, gamtat hoihna tawh hotkhiatna ngahna ding lampi om theilo hi. Pasian mai ah naupangte zong mawhnei ahih manin mawhna thaman ahi sihna leh gawtmun tawh kipelh theilo banah gentheihna tawh zong kipelh thei tuanlo hi. Mawhna neihloh hun (Piansakna pan Eden huan a hawlkhiat madeuh hun sung)  2. Sia leh pha khentel theih hun (Eden huan pan Tuiciin dong)  3. Mihingte thuneihna nuai ah om hun (Noah pan Abraham)  4. doctrine of christ.explanation: Khazih thu sutna. Khazih in pianngei nih: Pasian leh mihing pianngei, nei hi. Khazih in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a nihnapa hi. Khazih in na khempeuh piangsak hi. Khazih in na khempeuh thei hi. Mihing ahih hangin mawhna neilo hi. Zeisu tungah a kibanglo pianngei nam nih omkhawm hi. Zeisu in na khempeuh a piangsak leh mawhneite a honkhia Pasian hi. Vantung gam tunna dingin Zeisu bek lampi hi.

doctrine of church.explanation: Saptuam thu sutna. Saptuam in thuzuite hi. Zeisu in saptuam pankhia hi. Piter tungah Pasian in saptuam lamlo hi. Saptuam pen Israel tawh kilamdang hi. Saptuam pen Pentecost Ni in Jerusalem ah kipan hi. Saptuam in hehpihna tawh kalsuan hi. Hun khat ciangin Zeisu in saptuam hong la ding hi. Tuni in saptuam hun leh hehpihna hun hi a, hun khat ciangin hih hun bei ding hi.

doctrine of god.explanation: Pasian thu sutna. Pasian in na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian hi. Pasian pen siangtho in mawhna neilo hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah Pa bangin om hi. Pasian pen vangliatna khempeuh tawh kidim hi. Pasian in kipatna leh tawpna neilo hi. Pasian in kipatna leh tawpna hi. Ngeina leh biakna zui in pasian a om hangin a nungta Pasian tawh kilamdang hi. A nungta Pasian in mawhneite honkhia in, midik suaksak in, vantung gam tungsak hi.

doctrine of holy spirit.explanation: Khasiangtho thu sutna. Khasiangtho in Pasian hi. Mit tawh kimu theilo hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a thumnapa hi. Kipatna leh tawpna neilo hi. Na khempeuh a piangsakpa leh mawhneite lungsim ah upna a guanpa hi. Khasiangtho in Pasian tawh pumkhat hong suaksak hi. Tu in saptuam makaih hi. Laisiangtho gelhte uk hi.

doctrine of last things.explanation: Hun nung thu sutna. Tuni in hehpihna ni hi. A sawtlo in hih hun bei ding hi. Misiangthote a la dingin meitung pan lei ah Zeisu hong paikik ding hi. Misiangtho kilakna ah a piangthakte kihel dinga, mei tungah Zeisu in thaman pia ding hi. Laktohna sunga kihellote gimna lianpi sung lut ding hi. Kum 1000 maanna a tunma in Zeisu leitung ah a nihveina hong paikik ding hi. Kum 1000 maanna sungah Zeisu in kumpi sem ding hi. Tua banah van thak leh lei thak ah kipai ding hi. Kum 1000 maanna zawh ciangin a piangthak lo khempeuh Zeisu in Tokhom Kang mai ah thukhen dinga meilipi sungah khiasuk ding hi. Hih mun ah hehpihna cihbang om nawnlo hi.

doctrine of man.explanation: Mihing thu sutna. Pasian in ama lim leh mel sunin mihing bawl hi. Pasian in leivui leh ama hu gawmkhawm in mihing bawl hi. Adam tung pan numei, Eve, bawl leuleu hi. Pasian in Adam leh Eve tungah khang unla pung un, ci in, innkuan pankhia hi. Satan hangin mawhna sungah Adam a puk ciangin mi khempeuh mawhcip in Pasian maipha ngahna ding kisia hi. Mawhneite a honkhia dingin Zeisu hong pai hi. Hotkhiatna thu a tangko dingin Zeisu in thuzuite hong sawl hi (Sawl.1:8).

doctrine of salvation.explanation: Hotkhiatna thu sutna. Mi khempeuh Pasian mai ah mawhcip in Pasian gal kisuak hi (Rom 3:23). Mawhneite a honkhia dingin leitung ah Zeisu hong pai hi (Lk.19:10). Zeisu in mawhneite tang dingin sihna thuak hi. Zeisu hotkhiatna a umte in hotkhiatna ngah hi. Upna hangin hehpihna tawh Pasian mai ah dikkisakna kingah hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna dingin sum leh pai kisamlo in up ding bek hi. Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho kiang pan hotkhiatna hong pai hi. Pawlpi, nekkhawm leh thukham zuihna in hotkhiatna pialo hi. Upna bek tawh dikna kingah hi (Rom 5:1-2).

doctrine of sin.explanation: Mawhna thu sutna. Pasian in ama lim leh mel sunin Adam piangsak hi. Ahi zongin mawhna sungah hong pukcip ciangin Pasian tawh kikhen hi. Adam mawhna eite tungah nu leh pate tungtawn in hong kilawhsuk hi. Mawhna thaman sihna mi khempeuh tungah hong tung hi. Mawhna in Pasian thukham palsatna hi. Mawhna in Pasian tawh kikhenna hi. Pasian tawh kikhenna in sihna hi. Mawhna pan hong honkhia dingin Zeisu in sihna hong thuak hi. Upna hangin hehpihna tawh Pasian ta kisuak hi. Pasian in i mawhna khempeuh hong maisak hi. Zeisu sihna in Pasian hehna damsak hi.

documentary hypothesis.explanation: Pasian min tawh buaina. Hih pen Moses gelh Thukham laibu 5 te, Piancilna pan Thuhilhkikna, mun tuamtuam pan kum zalom 5 sunga kikaikhawm hi in, Moses gelh hilo hi, cihna hi. A tom in JEDP kizang hi. Piancilna pan Thuhilhkikna pen Moses gelh hi a, hilo i cih leh Pasian thu a nialte ihi hi. Laisiangtho sunga a masa bu 5 pen Moses gelh hilo a cite in Pasian min zong a tuamtuam kizang ahih manin Moses gelh hi theilo hi, cih lamin ngaihsun hi. Piancilna 1 ah Pasian min dingin Elohim kizang a, Piancilna 2 ah Pasian min dingin Yahweh (Jehovah) kizang hi. Hih mun ah J leh E kimu hi. Thuhilhkikna, Deuteronomy, pen 621BC in kigelh a, hih pen D in kiciamteh hi. Siampite siangtho nasep pen, Priestly Code, in kiciamteh a mun 4na pan a kingahna hi, ci in P tawh kiciamteh hi. Hihte tungtawn in JEDP hong piang hi. Ahi zongin hih JEDP in Thukham laibute, Piancilna pan Thuhilhkikna, pen Moses gelh ahihna nial hi. Zeisu in hih bu 5 Moses laibu ci hi (Lk.24:44; Jn.20:31).

eastern orthodoxy.explanation: Nisuahna lam a thuzuite. Nisuahna lam a Tanglai upna leh kalsuanna thupi khat hi. A munzui in updan tuamtuam om a tuate sungah Russian Orthodoxy, Greek Orthodoxy cihte zong kihel hi. Hihte banah Roman Catholicte upna leh Langpangte a kici Protestantism kalsuan dan zong kihel hi. AD 1054 hun in Constantinople a kimuhkhopna ah pope tanga paite leh a dangte sungah buaina leh kikhenna om in, Tanglai Upna, Nisuahna, leh Nitumna (Catholicism) kikhenna piang hi. Kilamdanna (1) Nisuahnate in, Eastern Church in, Khasiangtho pen Pa Pasian kiang pan hong pai hi, ci hi. Ahi zongin Nitumna lamte, RC leh Langpangte, in Pa leh Tapa kiang pan Khasiangtho hong pai hi, ci uhhi. Hih in kilamdanna lian mahmah khat hi. (2) Nisuahnate in pope in vangliatna lianpi leh thuneihna nei a, RC in pope a lianpen in ngaihsun in thuneihna khempeuh ama tungah suan uhhi. (3) Nisuahnate in biakna khempeuh 7 vei kimuhna sungah a khatveina kiplet in, RC in a 21 veina thupisak hi. (4) Nisuahna lamte in na khempeuh tungah Laisiangtho thuneihna, a piangthakte bek tui kiphum ding, nekkhawm in kilaihna omlo in ahi banga zat ding, Khasiangtho pen Pasian hi, Zeisu in kipatna neilo in a om tawntung Pasian hi, Mary pen mawhna neilo hilo in mawhnei khat mah hi a, Pasian nu hilo hi, Pasian in mi khempeuh masuan ding theikhol napi hotkhiatna ngah dingte sehkholhsa in neilo hi, milim mai ah kun ding hilo hi, hotkhiatna pen khan tawntung a kizom toto ding hi in picinna lam manawh ding hi, Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian in tapidaw upna laigil pen hi in, hih mimal thumte in a tuamciat hi in, Pasian pianngei a kibang in nei uhhi, ci hi. Hih bangin tanglai thuzuite sungah kilamdanna leh upna kituaklo tampi na om hi. Laisiangtho thupina kilang semsem a, Laisiangtho a kiplette kip paisuak hi.

ecclesiology.explanation: Saptuam thu sutna. Leitung a kimu thei thuzuite kipawlna genna hi. Saptuam thu sutna hi a, saptuam pen Thukhun Lui ah omlo in Thukhun Thak ah Zeisu in a pianna ding genkhol in (Mt.16:18), Pentecost Ni ciangin Jerusalem ah Khasiangtho nasepna tawh saptuam piang hi. Saptuam, tapidaw, cih pen kipawlna leh minam hilo in Zeisu a umte bek hi. Israel pen minam hi a, saptuam pen vantung mite hi. Saptuam pen Piter tungah kiphutlo in Zeisu in a kammal tungah phut hi. Saptuam pen sawltakte zangin Pasian in a kammal tawh piangsak hi. Mihing tungah saptuam kilam theilo hi. Saptuam pen a kimu thei leh a kimu theilo namnih om hi. A kimu thei saptuam in leitung ah om a, a piangthak khempeuh mit tawh kimu theilo saptuam sungah kihel hi. Saptuam lutang mihing hilo in Zeisu leh Laisiangtho hi. Saptuam a la dingin Zeisu in meitung tuangin lei ah khatvei hong kumsukkik ding hi. Saptuam in upna hanga hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna ngahte hi. Tuni leh tu hun in hehpihna hun hi in, a sawtlo in bei ding hi. Saptuam, tapidaw, piangthak cih pen Pasian kammal zakna, upna leh hehpihna bek tawh piang hi. Zeisu upna bek tawh Pasian ta kisuak thei in, vantung gamnuam kiluah ding hi.

elder/eldership.explanation: Saptuam makaite, tuucing. Pawlpi sung kalsuanna khempeuh limtak a encikpa, pawlpi a kempa, leh a cingpa hi. Hih pen tuucing, pastor, siampite hi. Greek presbyteros, ‘presbyter, elder’ makaipi, a vanpi, cihna hi in, Greek episkopos, ‘bishop’ leh poimen ‘pastor’ tuucing tawh kizangkhawm hi. Tua ahih manin Manglai a elder, bishop leh pastor cihte kammal kilamdang taleh ‘a nasep kibang’ hi. Pawlpi pawlkhat in elder leh bishop kilamdangsak in, elder niamsak in bishop sangsak zaw a, bishop pen tuucing mun ah, pastor ah, koih uhhi. Makaipi dinmun, elder, pen Paul in Timoti tungah limtak in gen hi (1Tim.3:1-7). Titu tungah zong Paul in na genthuah leuleu hi (Tit.1:5-9). Pawlpi sunga makaipi, elder/pastor in mawhpuakna lian mahmah nam 4: hilhna, makaihna, thungetsakna leh kepcingna, hi.

elements.explanation: Nekkhawm sunga kihel nate. Saptuam tungah sep leh zuih dinga hong kisawl thu nih sung pan khat hi a, hih in Topa Nitak Ankuang tawh kizom in, tua sunga van leh nate, moh leh lenggah tui genna hi. Zeisu in galte khutsung a tunma in nungzuite tawh nitak ankuang umkhawm a, moh la in hih in ka sa leh ka pumpi hi, ci hi. Moh in Zeisu pumpi a genna hi a, Zeisu pumpi taktak suaklo banah Zeisu ci leh sa kihello hi. Zeisu in hai la in, cih pen, lenggah tui a lakna hi a, note a dinga kibuakhia ka sisan hi, ci hi. Hih hun in Zeisu si nailo ahih manin lenggah tui pen Zeisu sisan lim bek hi. Tuni in Nekkhawm i nek ciangin lenggah tui pen Zeisu sisan tawh kilaih lo banah lenggah tui sungah Zeisu sisan kihello hi. Zeisu sisan leh pumpi in a sihna tawh beisuak a, moh leh lenggah tui sungah kihel theilo hi. Tua banah kilaihna zong omlo hi. Nekkhawm i nek ciangin, Pasian itna leh Zeisu hotkhiatna hanga kingah thuphate kiphawk phasan ahih manin nekkhawm ah Pasian thupha, khalam thupha, om hi. Mihingte in Pasian i phawk theihna pen Pasian hehpihna hi a, tua in Pasian thupha hi.

Theihna, Greek episteme, knowledge, pen theihna thu sutna hi in, diksakna, kipatna leh theihna bangzah in kiciangtan cih zong lak hi. Hih thu ah theihna i cih bang hiam! Bang kithei ding hiam! Bang kithei theilo ding hiam! Theihna koi ci ngah ding! Bang in theihna maan piangsak hiam cih ngaihsutna hi. Upna thu ah Pasian thu leh Pasian omna koi cibang a kithei thei hiam cih ahi hi. Pasian omna pen a piansaksa nate hangin, cosmological argument, kithei thei hi. Pasian pen bang cibang a kithei thei ding i cih ciangin ama hong kilaakna bek tawh kithei thei hi. Ahi zongin kilaakna, Laisiangtho bek, simlo in khuak theihna, mihingte theihna tungtawn in Pasian omzia kithei hi, cih zong upna hi. A maan leh a maanlo khentelna hi.

eternal blessings.explanation: A kip tawntung thuphate. Pasian in leitung a kizang ding thupha tampi hong piak hangin hun khat ciangin tua khempeuh kisia ding hi. A kip tawntung thuphate sungah hotkhiatna, tawntung bitna, khamuanna, Pasian ta suahna leh vantung innpi hong bawlsakna cihte kihel hi. Hih thuphate cikmah hunin kisia ngeilo ding hi.

eternal condemnation.explanation: Tawntung mawhpaihna. Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh in tawntung mawhpaihna leh gawtna meilipi sung tung dinga hotkhiatna tawh kipelh ding hi. A piangthaklote in gawtmun ah nitum ding hi (Mt.25:46).

eternal conscious punishment.explanation: Zeisu thukhenna. Khazih thukhenna khat hi. Mi khempeuh tungah Khazih in thukhen ding hi. Tuni a Pasian thu a donlo khempeuh zong hun khat ciangin A Kang Tokhom Mai a thukhenna ah Zeisu tawh kimu teitei ding hi (Mt.25:46). Zeisu thukhenna tawh kuamah kipelh theilo hi.

eternal consequences of sin.explanation: Mawhna thaman. Pasian in mawhna mudah in sihna tawh thukhen a, mi khempeuh sihna sung tung hi. Mawhna in Pasian tawh hong kikhensak in, mawhna thaman in sihna leh gentheihna hi. Kha sihna in tawntung sihna hi. Pumpi sihna in a ngeina hilo in mawhna thaman hi. Thuzuite sihna in kha leh pumpi kikhenna hi. A piangthaklote kha in tawntung sihna thuak hi.

eternal death.explanation: Tawntung sihna. Pasian thu uplohna in tawntung sihna piangsak hi. Pasian tawh kikhenna in tawntung sihna hi. Sihna pan suahtakna dingin Zeisu up ding hi.

eternal destiny.explanation: Tawpna mun. Pasian a um leh a umlote tawpna mun hi. Pasian a umte vantung tung dinga, Pasian a umlote gawtmun tung ding hi.

eternal generation of the son.explanation: Zeisu hong paikhiatna. Zeisu in Pa Pasian kiang pan hong pai hi. Ahi zongin Zeisu pen Pasian in piangsak hi, bawltawm hi, cihna hilo in, Zeisu in a tawntung in Pasian hi napi, Pa Pasian thu mangin leitung ah mihing bangin hong piangkhia hi. Pa Pasian leh Tapa Zeisu in Pasian hihna a kibang in nei a, a neuzaw leh a lianzaw cihbang omlo hi. Pa Pasian in Tapa tungah nuntak tawntungna ama thu in neisak hi (Jn.5:26). Tapa in Pa tungtawn in hong suak hi (1Jn.5:18). Tua hi a, Tapa a neite in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi.

eternal home.explanation: Tawntung innpi. A piangthak khempeuh in Zeisu bawlsa a kisia ngeilo ding tawntung innpi vantung kiluah ding hi. Hih mun tunna dingin Zeisu bek lampi hi in sepna leh sum tawh kilei theilo hi.

eternal joy.explanation: Tawntung lungnopna. Upna hangin Pasian ta a suak peuhmah in tawntung lungnopna ngah hi. Bangbang i tuak zongin a nungta upna in hong lungnuamsak tawntung hi. Upna maan in lungnopna kicing hong pia hi.

eternal king.explanation: Tawntung kumpipa. Zeisu in i tawntung kumpipa hi. Zeisu in vantung leh leitung a piangsakpa, mawhneite a honkhiapa, saptuam a pankhiapa, saptuam lutang leh kumpite kumpipa hi. Zeisu in thukhen mangpa hi.

eternal life.explanation: Nuntak tawntungna. Hotkhiatna thupha khat hi. Zeisu a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah a tankik theilo hi. Pasian pianngei tawh kizom a, Pasian itna leh hehna zong a tawntung vive hi. Pasian hong itna kip paisuak a, a thukhenna leh hehna, gawtmun, zong kip paisuak ding hi. Mi khat gawtmun a tun ciangin paikhiakik thei nawnlo hi. Nuntakna zong tawmvei sung bek hilo in a tawntung ding hi. Hotkhiatna pen tawmvei sung bek kimang ding leh a hoih i sep sung teng bek kimang ding hilo in a tawntung a hotkhiatna leh bitna hi. Pasian in tuuno min khumna laibupi sung pan hong hemkhia ngeilo ding hi. Hih pen hotkhiatna maan hi.

eternal love.explanation: Tawntung itna. Pasian itna kip tawntung a bei hun neilo hi. Mihingte ki-itna kiam thei leh bei thei hi. Pasian itna in a tawntung kimang ding itna hi. Tua ahih manin hotkhiatna khatvei i ngah leh a tawntung a dingin kicing hi.

eternal procession of the spirit.explanation: Khasiangtho hong paikhiatna. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ahi Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho kizopna hi in, Khasiangtho pen Tapa sawlna bek tawh hong pai hilo in Pa kiang pan hong pai hi. Khasiangtho pen Pa leh Tapa in piangsak cihna hilo in, Pa leh Tapa sangin neuzaw cihna zong hilo in, amaute kizopna lahna hi. Zeisu in Pa tawh kipawl in Khasiangtho a sawlna ding genkhol hi (Jn.14:26; 15:26; 16:7). Khasiangtho pen Pasian Kha leh Khazih Kha kici hi (Rom 8:9). Hih thu pen Latin in Filioque kici hi. A khiatna pen And also from the Son = Tapa kiang pan zong hi.

eternal punishment.explanation: Tawntung gimthuakna. A nungta Pasian thu a umlote tunna ding leh thuak dingte hi. Pasian thu a umlote in gimna thuak ding hi. Pasian thukhenna in gimna ding hi (Mt.25:46).

eternal redemption.explanation: Tawntung tatkhiatna. Zeisu hong tatkhiatna in tawmvei sung bek hilo in a tawntung a kimang ding tatkhiatna hi. Khatvei pianthakna in tawntung tatkhiatna leh bitna hi. Tatkhiatna in sihna mun, gawtmun, zawnna, natna, gentheihna, ngeina leh lauhna pan tatkhiatna hi.

eternal security.explanation: Tawntung bitna. Hotkhiatna thupha khat hi a, thuzuite tawntung bitna hi. Zeisu a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi (Jn.3:16;36). Pasian in mi khat a it ciangin a tawp dongin it hi. Mi khat a gupkhiat ciangin zong a tawp dongin gum a, it paisuak leh kem paisuak hi. Hotkhiatna kitankik theilo/tawntung bitna ngah, cih pen Laisiangtho in hong limgen pen thugil hi. Mi khat in Zeisu a up ciangin Pasian ta suak in cikmah in tua hotkhiatna mansuahkik theilo hi. Ahang in, Pasian itna kip tawntung hi. Hotkhiatna pen mihingte sep hilo in Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho sep hi a, mansuahkik theih ding hilo hi.

eternal will of god.explanation: Pasian deihna. Pasian in mihingte leh na khempeuh a dingin deihna lianpi nei hi. Mawhneite in hotkhiatna i ngah ding Pasian deihna hi. Mihingte in leitung nate tungah ukna neih ding, zi leh pasal neih ding, mimal pung ding, zi in pasal ukna mang ding, pasal in zi it ding, tate in nu leh pa thu mang ding, i makaite thu mang ding, kumpite thu mang ding, gupna thu tangko ding, midangte it ding, meigong tagahte hehpih ding cih Pasian deihna hi.

exegesis/exegetical theology.explanation: A bul a bal a kanna. Laisiangtho telkhehna hi a, grammar tawh kizui leh laimal tawh kizui a kiteltak a telkheh ding leh laigelhpa in a gennop pen gensak ding hi. Laisiangtho munte nung leh mai limtak a kantelna leh a gennop pen gensak a, eite nuntakna ah ahi banga zatkik ding hi. Tua panin upna maan, theihna maan leh hilhna maan piang dinga, eite nuntakna leh midangte nuntakna ah kilamdanna piangsak ding hi. Laisiangtho pen Hebrew, Aramaic leh Greek tawh kigelh masa in, kammal zatzia zong a hunhun in kilaih hi. Hihte panin Mangkam, Kawlkam leh Zopau tawh kiteikik a, Zolai tawh i tei ciangin laimal zatzia ah buaina tampi om hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian humopna, makaihna, tawh kigelh ahih manin telkhehna leh kantelna ah Khasiangtho panpihna kisam hi.

Mihing a piang peuhmah Pasian mai ah mawhnei hi (Rom 3:10,23).

extra calvinisticum.explanation: Calvin upna khat. Zeisu in Pasian hi a, mihing hong suah hangin mihingte bangin mawhna leh khialh theihna nei tuanlo hi. Zeisu in mihing ahih hangin leitung mihingte bangin khialh theihna neilo hi. Zeisu in mawhna bawl theilo hi. Zeisu in Pa sawlna bek hilo in ama teeltawmna tawh Pasian hi kimlai mihing hihna hong teel hi a, mihing ahih hangin mawhna neilo in Pasian pianngei a dim in leitung ah nei veve hi. extra nos.explanation: Hotkhiatna kipatna. Hotkhiatna pen a pualam pan hong pai cihna hi. Hih pen Martin Luther upna leh hilhna hi. Luther hun in mite in sepna leh pawlpi tha muang in hotkhiatna pen sepna tawh kingah hi. Ahi zongin Luther in dikkisakna pen mihing ahilo a pualam pan i zon ding hi in, tua pen Khazih dikna bek tawh eite in dikna i ngah ding hi, ci hi. Dikkisakna pen Pasian in midik ci a hong tangkona hi a, nekkhawm leh sum leh pai tawh Pasian mai ah dikna kingah theilo hi. Pasian in Khazih dikna, a pualam pan, eite tungah hong kilawhsak hi. Zeisu upna hangin dikna kingah hi.

faith and reason.explanation: Upna leh khuak zatna. Upna pen Pasian tungah kingakna hi in, khuak zatna pen mihingte hatna tunga kingakna hi. Upna tawh Pasian deihna kithei a, ngaihsutna in a maan pen hong tun zolo hi. Ahi zongin zakna leh ngaihsutna panin upna piang hi. Upna leh ngaihsutna tonkhawm hi.

faith in christ.explanation: Khazih upna. Pasian tapa Khazih upna bek tawh Pasian ta kisuak leh vantung gam kitung hi. Upna hangin hehpihna tawh Pasian mai ah dikkisakna kingah hi. Vantung tunna dingin Zeisu bek lampi hi. Khazih upna bek tawh Pasian ta kisuak hi. Khazih in Pasian hi. Khazih in mawhna khempeuh hong puaksak a tua in Pasian hehna damsak hi. Vantung tunna dingin Pasian in sum leh pai leh mihing sepna hong kalhlo in Zeisu bek up ding deih hi. Lungsim sung tawng pan Zeisu hotkhiatna a sangte bek Pa kiang, vantung, tung ding hi (Mt.7:21). A hoih sepna in pianthak zawh cianga kilangkhia ding hi.

faith of our forefathers.explanation: Tanglai pate upna. Tanglai pate ahi Noah, Abraham, Izek, Zakoh, Moses, Joshua a kipan kamsangte dongin Zeisu upna tawh dikkisakna ngahte leh upna tawh haksatna sungah gualzawhna ngahte hi. Tanglai pate mah bangin tuni in thuzuite zong Zeisu sisan tawh kilei in, upna tawh dikna ngah vive mah ihi hi. Ahang in, hotkhiatna ngahna dingin Pasian in lampi khat bek nei hi.

Mihingte in Pasian tung leh midangte tungah i cihtak zawhloh hangin eite tungah Pasian hong thumaan in citak tawntung hi (2Tim.2:13). Pasian cihtakna kikhel ngeilo hi. Pasian in mi khat a it ciangin a tawp dongin it hi. Mi khat a teel ciangin a tawp dongin gum vilvel hi. Pasian in Abraham sam a, a tawp dongin gum hi. Eite tungah Pasian hong citak tawntung hi. fear of god.explanation: Pasian kihtakna. Pasian in itna leh hehpihna bek tawh kidim Pasian hilo in a heh thei Pasian zong hi. Pasian pen kihtakhuai hi. Mawhna in Pasian hehsak ahih manin Pasian in thukhenna pia hi. Thuzuite in mawhna i bawl ciangin Pasian heh a, i mawhkik nawnlohna dingin hong thuhilh lai hi. Pasian pen a heh thei Pasian ahih manin kihtak ding hi. Pasian hehna mihingte a dingin lauhhuai hi. Pasian in ka mite hi a cih Israelte in Pasian muhna ah citak tawntung zolo ahih manin milim bia in, Pasian thu a theilote tawh kiteng in, phengtat uh a, tua ciangin Pasian in gamdangte khut ah ap in sila suak hi. Israelte Izipt ah kum 400 sila in om hi. Israelte, Saklamte, Assyria ah sila in om hi. Judahte Babylon ah kum 70 sung sila in om hi. Pasian a kihtak lohman hi a, Pasian thuhilhna hi. Cihtakna, sianthona, hanciamna, thanuamna in Pasian kihtakna hi. Eima ut banga gamtatna in Pasian kihtak lohna hi a, a sawtlo in thuhilhna hong pai ding hi. Pasian hehna pen thuak baihlo hi. Pasian a kitom ciangin a thuakzo omlo hi. Pasian kihtakna in pilna kipatna hi (Pau.1:7).

five articles of arminianism.explanation: Arminiante updan thu 5. Arminius’ updan leh Calvin updan kilehbulh hi. Arminiante upna ah: Pasian in ama theihkholhna tawh kizui in mite teeltuam hi. Kithoihna pen mi khempeuh a ding ahih manin mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna ngah ding hi. Hotkhiatna pen hehpihna bek tawh kingah hi. Hehpihna pen kisam napi kinial thei hi. Hotkhiatna pen deihtelna tunga kinga ahih manin kimansuah thei hi.

five points of calvinism.explanation: Calvin upna thu 5. Calvin upna leh hilhna sunga kihel thu 5 hi. (1) Mi khempeuh mawhcip in Pasian gal suak a, Pasian tawh kikhen in sihna mun zuan a, hotkhiatna kisam hi. (2) Ahi zongin Pasian in ahang omlo in ama vangliatna tawh kizui in hotkhiatna ngah ding mite tangtawng a kipan teeltuamsa in nei hi. (3) Zeisu in tua teeltuamte a dingin sihna hong thuak hi. Hotkhiatna kiciangtan hi. Pasian itna kikim lo hi. (4) Hotkhiatna pen eima deih hun a kingah hilo in Pasian in hong piak cianga kingah leh kipiangthak thei bek hi a, Pasian hehpihna nial theih hilo hi. Hehpihna bek tawh hotkhiatna kingah ahih manin Pasian vangliatna kidal zolo hi. Pasian in hotkhiatna hong piak hun ciang bek in kingah hi. (5) Mi khat in Zeisu Khazih a up takpi ciangin a kimansuah nawnlo ding tawntung bitna ngah hi. Pasian itna in tawmvei sung bek hilo in a tawntung a kimang ding itna hi. A piangthakte in tawntung bitna leh khamuanna ngah hi. Manglai in, Total Depravity, Unconditional Election, Limited Atonement, Irresistable Grace, Perseverance of Saints (TULIP).

five ways, the.explanation: Lampi 5. Thomas Aquinas, RC sunga mipil mahmah, upna leh hilhna hi a, Pasian thu sutna ah upna paipi 5 nei hi. (1) Pasian pen na khempeuh a kikhinsak, mover, Pasian hi. (2) Pasian pen na khempeuh a pianna dinga, cause, nasem hi. (3) Pasian pen mihing hilo in kisapna, necessity, a neilo Pasian hi. (4) Pasian pen na khempeuh a kicing leh a hoih a bawl, perfect cause, Pasian hi. (5) Pasian in na khempeuh a thei, intelligent, Pasian hi.

five wounds of christ.explanation: Liamma 5. Singlamteh tungah Zeisu hong sih ciangin liamma 5: a khutgel, a khelgel leh a pangpi tei tawh kidawt in liam hi.

forgiveness of sin.explanation: Mawh maisakna. Pasian bek in mihingte mawhna maisak thei hi. Mi khempeuh mawhnei hi a, Zeisu in singlamteh tungah sihna leh a sisan tawh hong tatkhiat ciangin mihingte mawhna khempeuh sawpsiang in hong maisak kiuhkeuh hi. A beisa mawhna, tulaitak a mawhna leh mailam ah i bawl ding mawhna khempeuh zong maisakna sungah kihel hi. Zeisu sisan sungah tatkhiatna leh mawh maina om hi (Efe.1:7). Mawh maisakna a ngahte in Pasian mai ah dikna, sianthona, goluahza leh Pasian innkuanpih hihna a kipan nuntak tawntungna ngah hi. Pawlpi in mawhneite mawhna maisak theilo hi. Pawlpi sunga siampi leh tuucingte in mihingte mawhna maisak theilo hi. Gamtat hoihna in mawhna liah zolo hi. Zeisu sihna in mawhna khempeuh sawpsiang in Pasian hehna thoihdam hi. Thuzuite sungah mawh kimaisakna in khamina leh picinna hi a, Khazih sutna hi. Khat leh khat mawhna kimaisak ding hi.
