freedom from being dead.explanation: Sihna pan suakta. Zeisu a umte in sihna pan suakta in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi. Hotkhiatna kitankik theilo hi. Upna in sihna pan thawhkikna hi (Efe.2:1-5).

freedom from being god’s enemies.explanation: Pasian gal pan suahtakna. Upna hanga hehpihna tawh dikna ngahte in Pasian gal hihna pan suakta in Pasian innkuanpih suak in goluah hi (Kol.1:21-22).

freedom from bondage.explanation: Sila pan suahtakna. Mi khempeuh mawhna sila hi. Ahi zongin Zeisu sisan hangin mi khempeuh mawhna sila pan suakta in nisim in Pasian hehpihna tawh nungta hi. Upna hangin suahtakna i ngah hi.

freedom from condemnation.explanation: Mawhpaihna pan suahtakna. Upna hanga dikna ngahte in mawhpaihna pan suakta in Pasian hehpihna tawh kidim hi. Pasian in a siangtho in hong sang hi (Rom 8:1).

freedom from culture.explanation: Ngeina pan suahtakna. Ngeina pen mihingte duh leh deih khempeuh genna hi. Ngeina pen Pasian a theilo tanglai pi leh pute tung pan i luahsuk hi a, dawi vangliatna tawh kizom hi. Ngeina sungah a hoih a om bangin a hoihlo zong om hi. Mi khat in upna tawh Khazih sungah om a Pasian ta a suahzawh ciangin ngeina in uk nawnlo in, ngeina vangliatna pan suahtakna ngah hi. Ngeina pen mihingte bawltawm leh updan khat bek hi a, bulkip neilo in kikhel den hi. Khazih hangin ngeina pan suahtakna kingah hi.

freedom from death.explanation: Sihna pan suahtakna. Zeisu in sihna tawh hong tatkhiat manin sihna pan i suakta hi. Pumpi sihna pen Pasian samsiatna hi a, a ngeina hilo hi. Mawhna in Pasian tawh hong kikhensak ahih manin kha sihna, tawntung sihna leh pumpi sihna kithuak hi. Thuzuite sihna in dahna ding hilo in kha leh pumpi kikhenna hi. Thuzuite in sihna zo in thokik ding hi.

freedom from doubt.explanation: Uplahna pan suahtakna. Mihingte lungsim sungah Satan in Pasian vangliatna leh Pasian itna uplahna hong guan hi. Tapidawte nuntakna sungah Pasian vangliatna uplahna zong Satan kiang pan hi. Ahi zongin Pasian theihtelna leh Zeisu upna tungtawn in uplahna pan kisuakta hi. Zeisu in Pasian pianngei hong hilh hi. Zeisu tungtawn in Pasian itna leh Pasian vangliatna kimukhia ahih manin uplahna teng hemkhia hi.

freedom from fear.explanation: Lauhna pan suahtakna. Lauhna leh patauhna pen mihingte ngeina khat hi. Mi khempeuh in mailam thu ding lungkham in mailam thu ding kitheinuam hi. Mailam ding a kihta vive ihi hi. Zeisu upna in Pasian maan theihna ahih manin Pasian thupina zong hong telsak a, lauhna leh kihtak theih a tuamtuamte pan suahtakna hong pia hi. Mihingte buainate sangin Khazih vanglian zaw hi. Khazih in na khempeuh a zawhsa hi a, eite zong tua zawhna tawh hong tonpih hi. Upna maan neite in lauhna pan suakta in lungnopna tawh kalsuan hi.

freedom from fear of failure.explanation: Lawhcin loh ding dahna pan suahtakna. Upna in suahtakna ahih manin Pasian tate in lawhcin loh ding lauhna leh patauhna panin suahtakna ngah hi. Pasian in i up ngamna zahzah thupha hong pia hi. Pasian in amah a muangte ompih in zawhna pia hi. Lawhcin loh ding lauhna in guallelhna hi napi, upna tawh a kalsuan ngamte in zawhna ngah uhhi.

freedom from fear of persecution.explanation: Bawlsiatna ding lauhna pan suahtakna. Zeisu upna hangin Pasian mai ah dikna ngahte in Pasian piak hangsanna leh suahtakna ngah ahih manin bawlsiatna thuak ding zong kihta nawnlo a, Pasian nasepna ah hangsan mahmah hi. Sawltakte in bawlsiatna thuak ding phamawh salo hi.

freedom from foolishness.explanation: Haina pan suahtakna. Upna tawh Pasian ta cihna a ngahte in Pasian tawh kizom ahih manin Pasian pilna ngah a, haina pan suakta in Pasian pilna tawh gamta hi. A piangthakte tungah Pasian pilna kilawh hi. Pasian in pilna hi a, dikna ngahna in haina pan suahtakna hi. Pasian tawh a kizom nilohte in pilna ngah hi.

freedom from god’s anger.explanation: Pasian hehna pan suahtakna. Hotkhiatna tawh hong tonkhawm khalam thupha hi in, Pasian hehna pan suahtakna hi. Zeisu sihna in Pasian lungkimsak ahih manin ama thangpaihna pan kisuakta hi (Efe.2:1-10).

freedom from governmental interferences.explanation: Kumpite bawlsiatna pan suahtakna. Saptuam puahphatna tunga kingate in saptuam tungah kumpi in thuneihna neilo banah hong bawlsia theilo ding ci hi. Tapidaw upna in a suakta upna hi a, kumpi in hong uk leh hong bawlsiat ding hilo hi. Zeisu hotkhiatna a ngahte tungah gam kumpi leh thuneite in hong nawngkaisak theilo ding hi.

freedom from grave.explanation: Han pan suahtakna. Han pan suahtakna pen hotkhiatna thupha khat hi. Mi khat a pianthak ciangin sihna zo a thawhkik ding khamuanna nei hi. Zeisu in sihna zo a hong thawhkik bangin Zeisu a umte zong ni khat ni ciangin sihna zo in thokik dinga hante hawm ding hi.

freedom from hell.explanation: Gawtmun pan suahtakna. Gawtmun pan suahtakna pen hotkhiatna thupha khat hi. Pasian in amah a umlote tunna ding gawtmun bawl hi. Ahi zongin Zeisu hotkhiatna a sang khempeuh gawtmun pan suakta in Pa Pasian omna, vantung gam, tung in sun leh zan in Pasian min phat ding hi. Zeisu upna hangin gawtmun pan suakta zo ihih manin tuni in lungdamna tawh Topa na sep ding bek omlai hi.

freedom from idleness.explanation: Thadahna pan suahtakna. Upna tawh dikkisakna ngahte in thadahna pan suakta in hanciamna tawh kalsuan hi. Upna in khuavak sung hong tun ahih manin a piangthakte in a sep ding thei hi. A piangthakte thanuam hi. Upna in thadahna pan suahtakna leh hanciamna kipatna hi. Pasian in a thadahte deihlo in a thanuamte bek sam in zang hi.

freedom from judgement.explanation: Thukhenna tawh kipelh. Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh tungah nitawp ni ciangin Zeisu in thukhen dinga, Zeisu hotkhiatna a pomte in thukhenna tawh kipelh ding hi.

freedom from lust.explanation: Deihgawhna pan suahtakna. Upna hangin ci leh sa deihna leh angsung theihna pan suaktakna kingah hi. Thuzuite in vantung gammite ahih manin leitung tawh kizopna neilo hi. Pasian a itte in leitung nate lunggulh lo hi. Upna in hukna leh lanna pan hong kem hi.

freedom from obeying people.explanation: Mi thu manna pan suahtakna. Laisiangtho sungah mite thu man ding leh man loh ding thu nih om hi. Laisiangtho in hong uk kumpite thu man ding leh gam thukhunte zuih ding hong sawl hi. Ahang in, Pasian phalna bek tawh mi khat kumpi suak thei hi. Thuneihna leh zaliatna Pasian piak hi (Rom 13:1; 1Pit.2:13-15). A langkhat ah, Laisiangtho in eite hong uk Pasian thu bek man ding deih hi. Khazih simloh leitung ah ‘Pa’ ci kei un. Vantung ah Pa khat bek na nei uhhi (Mt.23:9-10). Paul in, ‘Note man tawh kilei na hih manun, mite sila suak kei un’ ci hi (1Kor.7:23). Tapidawte in makai leh ukpi khat bek nei a, tua in Zeisu hi. Zeisu bek Topa hi. Zeisu thu bek zuih ding hi. Mihingte thu sangin Zeisu thu manzawk ding hi. Mihingte sangin Zeisu vanglian zaw hi. Pasian maipha ngah ding thupi pen hi.

freedom from poverty.explanation: Zawnna pan suahtakna. Zeisu a umte in zawnna pan suahtakna ngah hi. Lungsim zawnna, nek leh dawn a kipan inn leh lo ding kitangsapna tuamtuam kineiciat hi. Zeisu a umte in vantung gamnuam luah ding ahih manin mihaupi suak hi. Pasian in ama thu a um taktakte nuntakna kilamdangsak hi. Upna in hauhna hi.

freedom from pride.explanation: Kiphatsakna pan suahtakna. Kiphatsakna pen satan kiang pan hong pai hi. Upna in kiniamkhiatna hong pia in Pasian mai leh mite mai ah maipha hong ngahsak hi. Upna in kiphatsakna, satan lungsim, pan hong suahtaksak hi.

freedom from religious influences.explanation: Biakna ukna pan suahtakna. Upna in biakna ukna leh biakna vaite pan suahtakna hi. Biakna pen mihingte patkhiat hi in, a pankhiate deihna bangin kigamta hi. Tapidaw upna in Zeisu patkhiat ahih manin Zeisu deihna kizui a, biakna tawh kitonkhawm theilo hi.

freedom from satan.explanation: Satan khutsung pan suahtakna. Zeisu upna hanga hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna ngahte in Satan khutsung pan suakta in Pasian ta suak hi. Upna bek tawh Pasian ta kisuak hi. Mi khat a pianthakma in Satan neihsa hi in, hong pianthak ciangin Pasian ta suak in, Pasian goluah suak hi. Piangthakte tungah Satan in ukna neilo napi Satan in Pasian tawh i kizopna suksiat ding bek vaihawm hi. Thuzuite tungah Satan in Pasian phalna zahval sem theilo hi.

freedom from sickness.explanation: Natna pan suahtakna. Upna hangin natna pan suahtakna kingah hi. Zeisu sisan in kha bek damsak lo in i pumpi zong damsak hi. Zeisu liamma hangin damna bukim kingah hi (Is.53).

freedom from sin to serve god.headword: freedom from sin to serve god
translations: Freedom from Sin to Serve God
freedom from sin to serve god.explanation: Seploh mawhna pan suahtakna. Upna hangin Pasian in i mawhna khempeuh hong maisak hi. Pasian in ama na i seploh mawhna nangawn hong maisak hi (Lk.1:74).

freedom from slavery of sin.explanation: Mawhna sila pan suahtakna. Eden huanpi sungah Satan tung pan mawhna leh Pasian thangpaihna kipankhia a, mi khempeuh tungah mawhna leh mawhna thamante kilawh hi. Mawhna in mi khempeuh uk in, mawhna pen mihingte pianpih ngeina khat suak hi. Mawhna in Pasian tawh hong kidosak hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in Satan leh mawhna mudah ahih manin thukhen hi. Mawhna tungah Pasian in thukhen khinzo ahih manin mawhna vangliatna pan upna hangin suahtakna kingah hi. Mawhna pen thuzuite makaipi hi nawnlo in i gal suak hi. Zeisu in mawhna thukhen hi. I mawhna khempeuh Zeisu sisan in sawpsiang hi. Zeisu upna hangin mawhnei pan misiangtho kisuak hi. Mawhna pen kinial thei hi. Mawhna pen kitaisan thei hi. Zeisu in thuzuite hong uk a, mawhna in eite makai hilo hi. Upna tawh mawhna khutnuai pan suahtakna kingah hi.

freedom from sorrow.explanation: Dahna pan suahtakna. Upna hangin dahna namcin pan suahtakna kingah hi. Pasian in a tate tungah hehnepna leh lungmuanna pia hi. Upna hangin dahna, kahna, haksatna leh sihna tungah suahtakna kingah in, a gualzo pente ihi hi. Thuzuite lam ah Pasian pang hi (Rom 8:31). Upna maan in hong lungnuamsak hi.

freedom from supersitition.explanation: Khanglui upna pan suahtakna. Upna leh pianthakna hangin pianpih ngeina upna leh khanglui upna tuamtuamte pan suahtakna kingah hi. Satan in khanglui ngeina tuamtuam tawh hong hencip a, thuzui tampi in khanglui upna sungah awklai hi. Zeisu a umte leh a piangthakte tungah khanglui ngeina in bangmah hong nawngkaisak zo nawnlo hi.

freedom from the law.explanation: Thukham pan suahtakna. Thukham kalhna a cin zolo mihingte a honkhia dingin thukham nuai ah Zeisu hong suak in thukham kalhna khempeuh hong sepsak hi. Zeisu upna hangin thukham tawh kipelh in thukham ukna pan suahtakna kingah hi. Pasian in ama hehpihna tawh mawhna khempeuh hong maisak in a siangtho in hong sang hi. Thukham in hotkhiatna i kisaplam hong hilh hi. Zeisu hangin hehpihna sungah lungmuang in i om hi (Rom 6:4).

freedom from tradition.explanation: Bawltawm thukhun pan suahtakna. Upna hangin mawhna leh thukham pan suatka bek hilo mihingte bawltawm thukhun tuamtuam pan suahtakna kingah hi. Laisiangtho simloh i zuih ding thudang omlo hi.

freedom in christ.explanation: Khazih sungah suahtakna. Thukham in mi khempeuh hong hencip laitak Pasian in mihingte a honkhia dingin a Tapa Zeisu leitung ah hong sawl hi. Mi khat in Zeisu a up ciangin piansak thak hi in (2Kor.5:20), kihencipna khempeuh pan suakta hi. Zeisu upna hangin thukham vangliatna pan suahtakna, mawhna ukcipna pan suahtakna, mihingte bawltawm ngeina pan suahtakna leh sihna pan suahtakna kingah hi.

freedom of god.explanation: Pasian suahtakna. Pasian in khuahun, sun leh zante piangsak a, ahi zongin tuate in amah ukciplo hi. Pasian in na khempeuh tungah suahtakna ngah hi. Pasian a uk omlo hi. Piansakna a kipan hotkhiatna dongah Pasian in suaktatak in nasem hi. Ahi zongin Pasian suahtakna in mawh theihna leh khialh theihna tunlo hi.

freedom of men.explanation: Mihingte suahtakna. Mawhna bawl ding leh hoihna bawl ding, pianthak ding leh pianthak loh ding mihingte deihna tungah kinga hi. Ahang in, Eden huan ah Adam in singgah nek ding leh nekloh ding ama khensatna tungah kinga hi. Hotkhiatna pen eima ut hun peuh teh kisang thei hi, a cite in hih mun siksan hi.

freedom of will.explanation: Ut bangbang teel theihna. Mihingte in na khat peuhpeuh eima ut bangin teel theihna, sep theihna, nial theihna leh zuih theihna ngah hi. Mihingte in eima ut bangbang kiteel thei hi. Deihtelna pen mihingte hamphatna hi. Hotkhiatna zong eite deihtelna tungah kinga, eima ut hun peuh teh kingah thei hi. Arminius in hih bangin hilh hi. Ahi zongin Calvin in hotkhiatna pen Pasian piakte bek in ngah, ci hi.

freedom, christian.explanation: Thuzuite suahtakna. Zeisu upna tungtawn in Khasiangtho vangliatna tawh thuzuite in mawhna khutnuai leh thukham tuamtuamte tung pan suahtakna kingah hi (Gal.5:1).

freedom, human.explanation: Mihing suahtakna. Mihingte tungah pianpih suahtakna hong kipia a, eima ut banga om theihna kingah hi. Kim leh pam hoihna panin mihingte suahtakna kizangkhia thei hi. Kigakna a khauh ciangin mihingte suahtakna kimansuah hi.

glorification of god.explanation: Pasian min phatna. Thuzuite in Pasian vangliatna leh Pasian itna i pahtawina leh biakna i piakna hi. Pasian pen biakna leh phatna ngah dingin kilawm hi. Pahtawina khempeuh Pasian tungah piak ding hi.

glossolalia.explanation: Pautuamte. Greek glossa ‘tongue’ ; laleo, ‘to speak’, genkhia, pau cihna hi a, Khasiangtho letsongte sungah khat hi. Piangthakte sungah a kibuaipih leh pawlpi hong kikhensak kammal hi. Buaina khat pen tulai mite kampau dan maw, ahih keileh a kitheilo ahi bualbual maw, cih bangin ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Pentecost Ni in Sawltakte in a kithei paute, known languages, pau uh a, Aramaic pau a theilote in lunglut mahmah hi (Sawl.2:5-13). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pauna pen mihing tunga kigen hilo in Pasian tunga kigen leh kipau hizaw ahih manin ‘kuamah in a khiatna theilo hi’ (1Kor.14:2). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pen midangte theih dingin kilet ding, kamphen om ding hi, ci hi (1Kor.14:5, 27-28). Pentecostalte (AGte) in kamtuam pauna in pianthakna lak hi. A piangthakte in kamtuam pau zatloh phamawhsak in sinlai uhhi. Kamtuam pauna pen Khasiangtho ngahna tawh kizom hi. Pianthak khit hun khat ciangin Khasiangtho khuanung tun ci a, Khasiangtho ngahna dingin thu nakpi in ngen in kamtuam pau zong kisinsak uhhi. Mi khat a pianthak leh kamtuam pau pau ding ci hi. Ahi zongin Tuiphumte in kamtuam pen niallo in pautuam hizaw hi, ci hi. A khiatna a khia thei ding mi 2 kisam ahih manin hih pen a kitello ahi bualbualte hilo ding hi. Laisiangtho kicingta ahih manin pautuam kisam nawnlo a, pawlpi kipna dingin Pasian in ama kammal bek zang hi. Pautuam leh kamtuam khiatna kilamdang mahmah hi.

god almighty.explanation: A thahat Pasian. Pasian in hatna bucing nei a bangmah in susia zolo hi. Pasian gelna kuamah in susia theilo hi. Pasian in hatna bucing nei hi. Pasian in amah a umte bittak in kem hi.

god as necessary being.explanation: I kisap Pasian. Mihingte kisap pen Pasian hi. Pasian cih pen leitung mihingte kammal sung pan a thuk pen leh a manpha pen hi. Pasian a om manin Pasian min kilo hi. Mihingte in Pasian kisam hi.

god as subject.explanation: A thupi pen Pasian. Mihingte nuntakna ah i kisap leh a thupi tampi a omte sung pan Pasian leh ama thu mah a thupi pen hi. Pasian thu bek thumaan leh thutak hi. Mihingte kikhel zel napi Pasian kammal kikhel ngeilo hi. Pasian pen a thupi pen mun ah i koih leh eite hong lamsang ding hi.

god as trinity.explanation: Thum kigawm khat. Pasian pen khat bek om a, thum bangin kilang hi. Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in Pasian thum om hi cihna hilo in hih mimal thumte in Pasian pianngei a kibang in nei in, omkhawm tawntung uhhi. Tapidaw upna zungpi leh a telhak pen hi.

god, absoluteness of.explanation: Pasian bucinna. Pasian bek bucing in kikhel hun neilo hi.

god, acts of.explanation: Pasian septe. Mihingte tangthu sunga Pasian nasepna leh leitung a Pasian nasepna khempeuh Laisiangtho in hong hilh hi.

god, aseity of.explanation: Pasian omna. Pasian in a cil a kipan amah leh amah in om a, midang leh nate tungah kingakna neilo hi. Pasian in a om tawntung Pasian hi.

god, awareness of.explanation: Pasian thu lungngaihna. Pasian pen upmawh leh ngaihsutna bek hilo in a om takpi leh a taktak hi.

god, being of.explanation: Pasian pianngei. Pasian in a siangtho leh a thutang Pasian hi. A septe tungtawn in Pasian pianngei kithei hi. Pasian in mihingte it hi.

god, benevolence of.explanation: Pasian hoihna. Pasian in hoihna tawh kidim a, mihingte tungah siatna ding leh pukna ding tungsak lo hi. Pasian in mihingte a dingin a hoih bek gel hi.

god, breath of.explanation: Pasian hu. Pasian in mihingte tungah ama hu hong sangkhia a tua panin nuntakna kipan hi. Pasian tawh nuntakna kipan hi.

god, changelessness of.explanation: A kikhel ngeilo Pasian. Leitung nate leh mihingte kikhel niloh taleh Pasian in cikmah hunin kikhel ngeilo hi. A kammalte zong kikhel ngeilo hi. Immutability ah en in.

god, children of.explanation: Pasian tate. Zeisu Khazih upna tungtawn in mi khat in Pasian ta suak hi. Pasian in ama ta bangin hong sang hi (Jn.1:12).

god, consequent nature of.explanation: Pasian pianngei. Pasian in na khempeuh piangsak in, a piansaksa nate tawh kikhen ngeilo banah a piansaksa nate damdam in khangsak hi.

god, decretive will of.explanation: Pasian gelna. Na khempeuh Pasian gelna bangin piang hi. Pasian theihlohkal a piang bangmah omlo hi (Jn.1:3).

god, dependability of.explanation: Pasian muanhuaina. Pasian in mite lungsim ah amah up leh muan ding a kipan ama muanhuaina lak hi. Hih in Pasian thumaanna hi (Kah.3:23).

god, doctrine of.explanation: Pasian thu sutna. Tapidawte upna bulpi hi in, Pasian in kua hi a, Pasian in bang hi a, Pasian in bang sem a, mihingte tawh bang kizopna nei cih leh eite a dingin bang hong sepsak hiam cih sutna hi.

god, eternity of.explanation: A om tawntung Pasian. Pasian in kipatna leh tawpna neilo in a om tawntung Pasian hi. Leitung nate hun khat teh beimang dinga Pasian leh a kammalte bei ngeilo ding hi. Pasian kikhel theilo hi.

god, faithfulness of.explanation: Pasian thumaanna. Pasian in a kamciamte tangtungsak in, hehpihna tawh ama tate kem in haksatna sung nangawn ah taisan ngeilo hi. Amah a umte Pasian in bittak in kem hi (1Jn.1:9). Pasian in a tawntung in thumaan hi.

god, fatherhood of.explanation: Pa Pasian. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho om a, tuate sung pan Pa pen a thupi pen leh a lian pen danin kihopih a, na khempeuh ah Pa leh Pasian kici phadiak hi. A taktak in Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in pumkhat hi. Pasian i cih ciangin Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho genkhopna hi. Mihingte theih theih dingin Pa kizang a ahi zongin a lianzaw cihbang omlo hi.

god, foreknowledge of.explanation: Pasian theihkholhna. Mailam thu ding khempeuh theihkholhna leh hotkhiatna ngah dingte donga theihna pen mihingte tungah kipialo in Pasian bek in nei hi. Hotkhiatna ngahlo dingte zong Pasian in theikhol hi (Rom 8:29).

god, general will of.explanation: Pasian deihna. Pasian in a bawlsa na khempeuh a ding leh mihingte a dingin deihna leh gelna nei hi. Pasian in ama deihna tawh kituak a nuntak ding hong deih hi.

god, genuineness of.explanation: Pasian maan. Pasian in a nungta Pasian hi in, a bawlsa nate tawh kilamdang in milim tawh kilamdang hi. A nungta Pasian bek biak leh phat dingin kilawm hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian maan hong hilh hi.

god, good pleasure of.explanation: Pasian lungkimna. Pasian in ama thu in na khempeuh piangsak in a bawlsa nate tungah lungkim hi. Pasian tungah thunei kuamah omlo in na khempeuh ama hoihsak bangin piang hi (Efe.1:5).

god, goodness of.explanation: Pasian hoihna. Pasian in na khempeuh a hoih in piangsak banah amah a umte a dingin zong na khempeuh a hoih in piangsak hi.

god, government of.explanation: Pasian ukna. Pasian in na khempeuh uk in a kituak dimdiam in piangsak hi. Pasian in na khempeuh ama deih bangin piangsak hi.

god, grace of.explanation: Pasian hehpihna. Hehpihna in Pasian pianngeite sungah a thupi pen khat hi. Mawhneite tunna ding gawtmun hi napi, Pasian in itna leh hehpihna tawh kidim ahih manin gawtmun pan suahtakna dingin mihingte ngah dinga kilawmlo suahtakna lampi Zeisu tungtawn in hong bawlsak hi. A mawhcip mihingte in upna hangin hehpihna tawh mawhna dan pan suakta in Pasian ta cihna kingah a, vantung gammi suahna kingah in, Pasian in midik in hong mu banah ama goluah bangin hong ciamteh hi. Hehpihna pen lainatna, itna leh cihtakna tawh kipawl hi (Pai.34:6). Hehpihna pen mihingte tawh a kilawmlo Pasian itna tuam vilvel hi. Pasian in sepna leh thukham zuihna kihello in upna bek tawh a hehpihna hangin midik leh mihoih in hong sang hi (Rom 9:15). Hotkhiatna pen sepna tawh kingah theilo in upna bek tawh kingah hi. RC in Pasian hehpihna nekkhawm tungtawn in kilawh hi, ci a piangthakte in hih upna nial in, na khempeuh Pasian hehpihna bek tawh piang hi, ci hi.

god, greatness of.explanation: Pasian liatna. Pasian hatna, theihna, tawntung omna leh pilna in liatna khempeuh huam hi. Pasian liatna a demzo omlo hi. Pasian liatna Laisiangtho in hong hilh a, Pasian liatna bek phat dingin kilawm hi (Late 48:1).

god, holiness of.explanation: Pasian sianthona. Pasian in mawhna tawh kisawhkha theilo hi. Pasian in mawhna bawllo hi. Pasian pen siangtho ahih manin mawhna in zolo hi. Pasian in thuzuite amah tawh kibang a siantho ding hong deih hi. Sianthona in mawhna tawh kikhenkhiatna hi (Is.6:3).

god, image of.explanation: Pasian lim. Mihingte in Pasian lim leh mel kisun hi (Pian.1:26-27). Pasian pianngei leh lim pen Zeisu tungtawn in kimu hi. Zeisu in mit tawh a kimu theilo Pasian lim hi (Kol.1:15). Ngaihsutna, deihtel theihna, thu theihna in a dang Pasian piansakte tawh kilamdang hi. Pasian in nate tung leh ganhingte tungah ukna leh thuneihna hong pia a, hamphatna lianpi hi. Khazih in Pasian lim ahih bangin thuzuite in Pasian lim leh mel kipua hi. Mi khempeuh in hih pianngei kingah hi. Leitung ah mawhna hong lut hangin hih pianngei, Pasian lim leh mel sutna, susia theilo hi.

god, immanence of.explanation: Pasian omna. Pasian in a bawlsa nate tawh kikhen ngeilo in ompih den hi.

god, immateriality of.explanation: Pumpi a neilo Pasian. Pasian in a tawntung in kha ahih manin pumpi neilo a, kisukha theilo hi. Pasian in kha hi.

god, immensity of.explanation: Kiteh theilo. Pasian liatna leh hatna kiteh theilo hi. Pasian in liatna leh hatna khempeuh nei hi.

god, immutability of.explanation: A kikhel ngeilo Pasian. Pasian kikhel ngeilo hi. A gelna zong kipelh ngeilo hi. Pasian kammal kip tawntung hi.

god, impassibility of.explanation: Pasian kikhel ngeilo. Pasian kikhel ngeilo hi. Leitung nate in Pasian pianngei susia theilo hi. Pasian in gentheihna leh natna thuak ngeilo hi.

god, inclusive language about.explanation: Kammal thupina. Numei leh pasal in Pasian pianngei hong lak hi. Numei leh pasal in Pasian omzia hong lak hi (Is.49:15; Lk.15:20).

god, incomprehensibility of.explanation: Telsiang theihloh Pasian. Mihingte theihna in Pasian nasepte leh Pasian pianngeite ahi bangin telsiang theilo hi. Mihingte in Pasian omna leh Pasian pianngei kithei thei napi, telsiangna hong pialo hi.

god, independence of.explanation: Pasian suahtakna. Pasian pen suakta mahmah in mihingte leh kuama tungah kingalo hi. Pasian pen Pasian ahih manin mihingte tawh kilamdang in bangmah in dal theilo hi. Pasian in na khempeuh piangsak (Sawl.17:24); amah leh amah in nuntakna nei (Jn.5:26); nuntakna pia (Sawl.17:25); na khempeuh ama a dingin piangsak (Kol.1:16-17); na khempeuh ama minthanna dingin piangsak hi (Rom 8:28). Pasian sepna ah dotna kibawl theilo hi.

god, infinity of.explanation: Pasian bucinna. Pasian in kiciangtanna neilo hi. Pasian hatna leh pilna kiciangtan lo hi. Pasian pen hun in uklo hi. Pasian tungah kuamah in thunei theilo hi. Pasian pen tehpih ding omlo hi. Pasian in na khempeuh ah bucing hi.

god, integrity of.explanation: Pasian cihtakna. Pasian in a thu khel ngeilo in a gen bangin sem in tangtung hi. Pasian in ama pianngei tawh kilehbulh in nasem ngeilo hi. Pasian thu kip tawntung hi.

god, interdependence of.explanation: Pasian kingakna. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ahi Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in kingakna nei dimdiam a cikmah in kikhen ngeilo hi. Kipatna a neihloh mah bangin tawpna zong neilo hi.

god, invisibility of.explanation: Pasian kimu theilo. Pasian in kha ahih manin kimu theilo leh kisukha theilo hi. Pasian in mit tawh muh ding utlo in lungsim tawh up ding deih hi.

god, justice of.explanation: Pasian thutakna. Pasian thutakna pen mun khempeuh ah kimu hi. Pasian in a gelsa bangin tangtungsak hi. Pasian in a tawntung in thutak hi. Pasian in ama sep leh bawl ding khempeuhte tungah thumaan in, kawkna ding neilo hi. Thukhun khat a palsatte tungah khalna kipia thei hi. Thumaanna pen Pasian pianngei khat hi in, amah in na khempeuh a kilawm bangin sem hi. Mawhnei mihingte in thukham zuihna tawh Pasian mai ah dikna leh thumaanna ngah zolo ihih manin Zeisu up ding kisam hi. Zeisu upna hangin Pasian mai ah dikna kingah hi. Zeisu hangin a citak theite ihi hi. Pasian in a tawntung in thutak hi.

god, kingdom of.explanation: Pasian ukna. Laisiangtho sungah a thupi mahmah kammal khat hi in, Pasian ukna hi. Pasian ukna sungah (1) Pasian in a bawlsa na khempeuh tungah ukna nei hi (Late 47:7). (2) Abraham tungtawn a Pasian in a teeltuam leh ka mite hi a cih Israelte Pasian in uk hi (Pai.19:5-6). (3) David kumpipa ukna leh a kizom paisuak ding ukna (2Sam.7). (4) Pasian ukna gam pen lungdamna thu genna leh Zeisu upna tawh eite tungah hong tung khinzo ahihna (Mk.1:14-15). (5) Upna tawh Vantung gam i tunkhit hangin leitung ah omlai, Already, Not Yet, ihih manin i tawntung mun ding pen mailam ah i ngah ding hamphatna hi (Mt.25:34). Pasian gam leh ukna mundang ah omlo in i lungsim ah om hi.

god, knowledge of.explanation: Pasian theihna. Mihingte in Pasian i theihna hi. Pasian kici tampite sung pan a nungta leh a vanglian Pasian theihna hi. A vanglian Pasian theihna in hotkhiatna hong ngahsak in, ei leh ei dinmun hong kitelsak in, hih theihna in Pasian tungah kipiaknopna hong guan hi. Mihingte in mawhnei ihih manin a vanglian Pasian omna, Pasian pianzia leh Pasian pianngeite theih ding haksa hi. Mihingte in Pasian i theihna dingin Pasian hong kilaakkhia hi. Piansakna tungtawn in Pasian om hi, cih kithei hi. Zeisu leh Laisiangtho tungtawn in Pasian omna leh Pasian pianngeite a kicing zaw in kithei hi. Ahi zongin mihingte in Pasian pianngei khempeuh ahi bangin kitel theilo, incomprehensible, hi. Mi khat in Pasian a theih ciangin ama dinmun leh ama hihna zong kithei hi.

god, law of.explanation: Pasian thukham. Pasian thukham in siatna ding hilo in hoihna ding leh pianthakna ding hi. Pasian thukham in itna hi. Itna a neilote leh midangte mawhna a maisak zolote in Pasian thukham palsat hi. Pasian thukhamte siangtho in manpha hi.

god, life of.explanation: Pasian nuntakna. Pasian in mihingte bawltawm pasian leh nate tawh kilamdang in nuntakna, vangliatna leh hatna bucing nei a, amah bek phat leh pahtawi dingin kilawm hi. Pasian a nungta tawntung Pasian hi in, si theilo hi. A si thei leh a kisia theite Pasian cih dingin kilawm lo hi.

god, love of.explanation: Pasian itna. Itna in Pasian pianngei khat hi. Hih pianngei pen mihingte tungah zong hong pia hi. Pasian itna kip tawntung a mihingte itna kiplo hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ahi Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in itna tawh kizom uhhi. Ama lim leh mel sun dinga a bawl mihingte a pukcip leh mawhna a bawl hangin Pasian in it teitei a, Zeisu tawh honkhia hi. Zeisu in a galte a dingin sihna thuak hi. Pasian in a tapa khat neihsun piakkhiatna tawh ama itna hong lak hi. Mihingte zong khat leh khat ki-it ding hong deih hi. Midangte it ding zong hong deih hi. I galte it ding hi.

god, majesty of.explanation: Pasian thupina. A nungta Pasian in thupina leh vangliatna khempeuh tawh kidim hi. Hih Pasian in kipatna leh tawpna neilo banah nadangte tungah thunei in ama deih bangin na khempeuh piang hi. Pasian in hatna bucing nei hi (1Khang.29:11; Late 29:4; 104:1; Is.33:3).

god, mercy of.explanation: Pasian lainatna. Mawhneite tung leh haksatna a thuak thuzuite tungah Pasian lainatna leh hehpihna hong luanna hi (Late 119:156; Jer.31:20; Dan.9:9).

god, moral purity of.explanation: Pasian sianthona. Pasian in a cil a kipan siangtho ahih manin mawhna leh zuau tawh kisawhkha theilo hi.

god, names of.explanation: Pasian minte. Thukhun Lui leh Thak sungah Pasian minte kimu a, tua minte in ama hihna leh sep ding khempeuh zong hong lakkhol hi. Pasian pen thum hilo in khat bek hi a, a piangsakpa, a tankhiapa, a kemcingpa leh nuntakna piapa hi.

god, nature of.explanation: Pasian zia. Pasian in a bawlsa nate tawh kilamdang hi. Pasian in a piangsakpa, a tankhiapa leh a kemcingpa hi.

god, omnipotence of.explanation: Na khempeuh hih thei. Pasian in na khempeuh hih thei hi. Pasian in mawhna bawl theilo hi. Pasian in hatna khempeuh nei hi. Mihingte hatna kiciangtan a, Pasian hatna kiciangtan theilo hi (Job 42:2; Mt.19:26; Lk.1:37).

god, omnipresence of.explanation: Mun khempeuh a om. Pasian in nate sungah omlo in mun khempeuh ah om a, Pasian kiang pan kuamah taisim theilo, taikhia theilo hi. Pasian tawh a kipelh thei kuamah omlo hi (Late 139:7-10; Jer.23:23-24).

god, omniscience of.explanation: Na khempeuh thei. Pasian in na khempeuh thei hi. A beisa, tuni leh mailam ah hong piang ding khempeuh zong thei hi. Pasian in i sepna khempeuh hong thei hi. Pasian in ihihna khempeuh ahi bangin hong mu hi (Heb.4:13).

god, oneness of.explanation: Khat hihna. Pasian in a tawntung in khat hi in, Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian: Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho, bangin kilangkhia den hi.

god, perfection of.explanation: Pasian bucinna. Pasian in kisapna leh kitaklahna neilo hi. Pasian pen gensiatna ding omlo hi.

god, persistence of.explanation: Pasian tupna. Pasian in mawhnei mihingte hotkhiat ding a gelsa ahih manin a hun a cin dong ngak in semkhia takpi hi.

god, personality of.explanation: Mihing ahihna. Pasian in mihingte theih ding ut ahih manin mihing bangin hong kilaakkhia a, huih bangin kilaakkhia lo hi.

god, plan of.explanation: Pasian gelna. Piansakna a kipan Zeisu sihna dongin Pasian gelna kimu a tua in mawhna pan kihotkhiatna ding leh sihna pan vantung tunna ding hi. Pasian gelna in mite a dingin a hoih vive hi.

god, power of.explanation: Pasian hatna. Pasian in a gelsa khempeuh tangtungsak in hatna bucing tawh kidim hi.

god, preceptive will of.explanation: Pasian gelna. Leitung pianma pek a Pasian gelnate damdam in mihingte tungah tangtung hi. Tu hun a tangtung nailote zong hun khat ciangin tangtung ding hi. Pasian gelna kipelh ngeilo hi.

god, primordial nature of.explanation: A kikhel ngeilo pianngei. Pasian pianngeite kikhel ngeilo hi. A gelsa bangin nate tangtung deudeu ding hi.

god, righteousness of.explanation: Pasian dikna. Pasian in dikna leh hoihna khempeuh kipatna hi. Pasian gelna khempeuh hoih in manpha hi. Pasian in Zeisu tungtawn in amah a umte tungah dikna hong pia hi. Dikkisakna in Pasian hong hehpihna thupha hi (Rom 1:17; 3:21-23).

god, simplicity of.explanation: Pasian kicinna. Pasian in kiciangtanna neilo in na khempeuh tungah kicing hi. Pasian pen a dalzo leh a nangzo omlo hi. Hoihna leh hatna khempeuh Pasian tungah kicing hi.

god, sinlessness of.explanation: Mawhna neilo Pasian. Pasian in thumaanna leh sianthona tawh kidim Pasian ahih manin mawhna neilo hi. A gelna, a genkhiatna leh a sepna tungah mawh matna ding omlo hi. Pasian in mawhna tawh kipelh hi. Mawhna in mihing pianngei hi in, sianthona leh mawh neihlohna in Pasian pianngei hi.

god, sovereignty of.explanation: Pasian thupina. Pasian pen a vanglian leh a thahat mahmah Pasian hi in, a piansaksa nate leh ama bawlsa mihingte tungah ukna a neipa hi. Pasian in a piansaksa vantung, leitung leh a sunga om na khempeuh limtak in kem a, nusia ngeilo hi. Mawhna in mihingte leh Pasian hong kikhensak hangin Pasian in kizopkikna ding leh hotkhiatna ding lampi Zeisu tungtawn in bawltawm in hotkhiatna hong pia hi. Mihingte pen ithuailo hi taleh ama hehpihna tawh Pasian in upna hong pia in hotkhiatna hong pia hi. Pasian in mawhna, Satan leh dawite tung dongah ukna nei hi. Pasian nasepna kuamah in nang zolo hi. Na khempeuh Pasian gelsa bangin piang hi. Pasian thahatna kuamah in dal zolo hi.

god, spirit of.explanation: Pasian kha. Khasiangtho in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a thumnapa hi (Rom 8:9; 1Kor.12:3; Efe.4:30).

god, transcendence of.explanation: Pasian hatna. Pasian in a bawlsa leitung leh nate sangin thupi zaw leh hat zawtham hi.

god, unity of.explanation: Pasian kipumkhatna. Pasian in khat bek hi in, tua sungah Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho, mimal tuamtuam thum omkhawm hi.

god, veracity of.explanation: A taktak Pasian. Pasian in a taktak Pasian hi in, phuahtawm hilo hi. Pasian in tangtawng a kipan a om takpi leh a nungta takpi Pasian hi.

god, victory of.explanation: Pasian gualzawhna. Pasian hatna leh vangliatna bangmah in dal zolo hi. Satan in Pasian gelna susia zolo hi. Job nuntakna ah Satan in Pasian phalna zahval susia theilo hi. Pasian in a gualzo Pasian hi. Pasian tawh a kipawlte gualzo tawntung hi. Pasian hatna leh gualzawhna Israelte tungah kimu hi. Pasian in a tate ompih in zawhna pia hi.

god, will of.explanation: Pasian deihna. Pasian in ama deihna a zui dingin hong deih hi. (1) Pasian in na khempeuh ama deih bangin gel a tuate in ama deihna banga gamtat ding hi. A kimu thei Pasian piansakte in Pasian deihna leh ama thusim hong lak hi. (2) Pasian in Laisiangtho tungtawn in ama deihna hong lakkhia in mihingte in i kalsuan zia ding kithei hi. Mihingte in Pasian deihna kithei in zuihna leh zuih lohna in eima khensatna tungah kinga hi. I sepna tawh kizui in Pasian in thu hong khen ding hi. Pasian deihna a zuite in thupha ngah dinga thukhenna tawh kipelh ding hi. Pasian deihna a zuilote in Pasian hehna thuak ding hi.

god, wisdom of.explanation: Pasian lungpilna. Pasian pil mahmah in na khempeuh thei hi. Lungpilna in Pasian pianngei khat hi in, Pasian in na khempeuh thei in, mi khempeuh leh na khempeuh tungah gelna kician nei hi. Piansakna: vantung, leitung leh a sunga om na khempeuh in Pasian ciimna, Pasian theihna, Pasian pilna leh Pasian ngaihsutna hong lak hi. Pasian in ama ciimna tawh na khempeuh piangsak hi (Late 104:24-25). Pasian in ama ciimna leh pilna tawh hotkhiatna piangsak hi. Ahi zongin mihaite a dingin haina suak hi (1Kor.1:18-31). Piansakna in Pasian ciimna hong lak hi. Saptuam tungtawn in Pasian ciimna kilang hi (Efe.3:10). Pasian ciimna pen thungetna (Jeim 1:5) leh Laisiangtho tungtawn in kingah hi (Late 119:99). Zeisu in Pasian ciimna hi (1Kor.1:30). Mi khat a pianthak ciangin Pasian ciimna leh Pasian pilna ama tungah kilawh ahih manin khantohna in zui hi.

god, worship of.explanation: Pasian biakna. Na khempeuhte sanga thupisak zawkna tawh Pasian vangliatna leh itna pahtawina hi. Pasian in phat leh pahtawi dingin kilawm hi.

god, wrath of.explanation: Pasian thangpaihna. Satan in Pasian hehsak hi. Adam in Pasian hehsak hi. Mawhna in Pasian hehsak hi. Pasian in mihingte a kipan leitang dongin samsiat hi. Pasian hehna thuakhak mahmah hi.

goddess.explanation: Nusian. Pasian cih kammal in pasal thupina leh pasal lim lak ahih manin a langkhat ah Nusian, numei tawh kibang vangliatna nei om ding hi, cih updan nam khat hi. Pasian i cih bangin Nusian zong cih ding hi. Feministte updan hi.

god–breathed (inspiration).explanation: Pasian humop. Laisiangtho pen Pasian humopna tawh kigelh hi. Pasian in a gelhte uk leh makaih in mihingte deihna kihelsaklo hi. Laisiangtho gelhte in Pasian hilh bangin gelh uh a, mihing ngaihsutna kizang theilo hi. Pasian humopna tawh kigelh ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo hi. Pasian in dikna tawh kidim ahih manin a kammal zong dikna leh sianthona tawh kidim in Laisiangtho pen Pasian kammal ahihna muanhuai hi. Pasian in eite tungah ama kammal tawh hong kilaak hi. Pasian kammal khempeuh siangtho in vangliatna tawh kidim ahih manin eite tunga thunei ding in kicing hi. Saptuam sungah thunei pen Laisianghto hi. Inspiration ah en in.

god’s curse.explanation: Pasian samsiatna. Satan hong puak mawhna in Pasian thangpaisak ahih manin pasal khempeuh, numei khempeuh, leitang leh ganhingte tung dongah Pasian samsiatna tung hi. Pasian in a it thei leh a hehpih thei Pasian bek hilo in a thangpai thei Pasian leh mawhna peuhmah a khahkhong ngeilo Pasian ahih manin Pasian pen kihtakhuai hi. Solomon genna ah, ‘Topa kihtakna in pilna kipatna hi’ (Pau.1:7).

good works.explanation: Na hoih sem. Khat leh khat tungah thupha kibawlna leh kihuhna hi a, thuzuite sep loh phamawh hi. Gamtat hoihna leh thupha bawlna in kha hotdamna hong piak theihloh hangin na hoih sepna pen hotkhiatna pan hong luangkhia hi. Na hoih sepna pen Pasian ta hihna leh pianthakna lahkhiatna hi. Na hoih sepna in Pasian lungkimsak in Pasian min thangsak hi. Na hoih sepna omlo upna in a si hi ci in, Jeim in hilh a, hun khat lai in Martin Luther in hih laibu Laisiangtho sungah hel dingin kilawm lo hi, na cingei hi. Ahi zongin Jeim in hotkhiatna a thupina nusia ngeilo leh painelh ngeilo in, upna tawh Pasian ta a suakte in na hoih sep ding hi, cih gen hi. Paul in, ‘Pasian in na hoih a sem dingin hong honkhia leh hong piangsak hi,’ ci hi (Efe.2:10).

great commandment.explanation: Thupiak. A lian mahmah thupiak hi in, Pasian in ei leh ei i ki-it banga midangte it ding leh, ei tunga hong kibawl ding i deih banga midangte tungah bawl ding, cihte hi (Mt.22:37-40). Thupiakte pen zuih ding hi. Tapidawte in Pasian thupiakte a zui dingte ihi hi. Khat leh khat ki-itna leh midangte itna pen ‘Khazih thukham’ kici a (Gal.6:2), Jeim in ‘suahtakna thukham’ ci leuleu hi (Jeim 2:12). Zeisu in makai leh thunei dingin hong samlo in nungzui ding leh ama thu a mang masa dingin hong sam hi. Nungzuite in Zeisu sawl bangin sem hi. Thumanna pen khantohna in zui hi. A thumangte bek Pasian in zang thei hi.

great commission.explanation: Sawlna lian. Zeisu in vantung ah a kah ding cianga sawltakte tungah nasep a piakna leh sawlkhiatna hi. Zeisu in nungzuite tungah sep ding pia hi (Mt.28:19-20; Sawl.1:8). Hih nasep pen thuzui khempeuh sep ding hi a, Pasian hong piak hauhna, hatna, siamna, pilna leh hih theih bangbang tawh sep ding hi. Hih nasep pen a mangthang khate in Zeisu a muhna ding leh upna ding hi in, tua in saptuam khanna hi. A nungta saptuam in gammial ah kuan in lungdamna thu leh Pasian itna tangko hi. Pasian in a piansaksate zang hi. Tua zawh teh upna sunga mi hangsante zang hi. Tua zawh teh Thukhente a kipan Kumpite leh Kamsangte zang in ama gelna tangkosak hi. Israelte in Pasian sawltak hi. Thukhun Thak ah Zeisu in a kithuahpih ding mi 12 sam hi. Zeisu in Paul sam hi. Sawltakte hun beita a, tuni pen eima sep hun hi in, a piangthak khempeuh, pawlpi khempeuh gupna thu gen dingin hong kisawl hi. Laisiangtho bute khempeuh ah upna tawh gupna leh dikna kingah cih kimu hi. Pasian in mawhneite it in, lungdamna thu bek tawh mawhneite samkik hi. Lungdamna thu bek tawh mite kikhel a, a genkhia ding thuzuite hong sawlkhia hi. Lungdamna thu tangkona in tapidawte nasep lak ah a thupi pen hi. Zeisu in Sawltakte tungah ‘Pa in kei hong sawl bangin note kong sawl hi, paikhia un’ ci hi (Jn.20:21). Hih nasep in pawlpi si leh pawlpi hing kilamdanna hi.

great tribulation.explanation: Gimna lianpi. Hehpihna hun, saptuam hun, sunga Pasian itna a pomlote leh Pasian a langdo khempeuh Gimna lianpi sung lut ding hi. A sawtlo in Zeisu in meitung tuangin lei ah hong kumsuk in saptuam hong la dinga, tua zawh teh Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh Gimna lianpi sung lut ding hi (Mt.24:15; 2The.2:3-4).

great white throne judgment.explanation: Tokhom Kang Mai ah thukhenna. Mihingte tungah thukhenna tampi tung ding hi. A Kang Tokhom Mai a thukhenna pen Pasian a umlo khempeuhte tungah Zeisu in kum 1000 maanna zawh cianga thu a khenna ding hi in, a piangthakte tawh kizopna omlo hi. Tuni a Pasian thu a umlote zong hun khat ciangin Zeisu tawh kitalsik teitei ding uhhi. Hih thukhenna a thuakte in meilipi sungah lutsuak ding uhhi. Thukhenna khempeuh ah Zeisu in a thutang thukhen mangpa hi.

Naupangte zong Pasian muhna ah mawhnei ahih manin a mawhsa in nu sung pan suakkhia hi. A mawhcip mihingte in hotkhiatna kisam hi. Zeisu bek in hong honkhia thei hi. holiness movements.explanation: Sianthona ultungsak updan. Pawlpi min khat leh kalsuan dan khat hi. John Wesley thuhilhna tungtawn in pawlkhat in upna thak mukhia in, Methodist pawlpi pankhia a, John Wesley tamsak in, John Wesley phuhkhiat pawlpi hi, ci uhhi. Methodist a kicite sungah upna tuamtuam hong pian ciangin kikhenna hong om a, pawlpi min tuamtuam hong piang in, tuate sungah Holiness in khat hi. Hih pawlpi in Arminius upna leh hilhna zui in, Pasian tungah kingalo in mihing thupina masak uhhi. John Calvin upna tawh kilehbulh hi. Sianthona ultungsakte in Pasian in mihingte mawhna hong maisak ciangin a vekpi in hong maisak in, a siangtho mahmah in zong hong sang hi. Mi khat a pianthak ciangin siangtho a, a sepna khempeuh ah Pasian a lungkim in mawh thei nawnlo hi, sinless perfection, cih zah dong in ngaihsun uhhi.

Pasian saptuam in upna tawh Zeisu a pom phet in Pasian in sianthona piapah in sianthona ngahpah hi. Tua banah nisim in thuzuite in Zeisu sutna tawh kalsuan a mawhnate pelh a nuntakna kisam hi. Hih bang nuntakna pen sih dong leh Zeisu hong paikik dong ding hi. Sianthona in Pasian kihtakna tawh kipan a, Pasian zia tawh zong kibang hi.

homiletics.explanation: Biakinn sunga thuhilh zia. Pasian nasemte neih ding leh theih dinga kisam mahmah khat in thuhilh siamna hi. Thuhilh zia tampi om hi. Laisiangtho sung thu telkhehna ah zong haksatna om hi. Thuhilhte in mite leh Pasian kikal ah palai, lei, bridge, ahih manin thuhilhna neubawl ding hilo hi. Thuhilh zia pen (1) Eima deih thulu khat bawltawm a Laisiangtho ei deih teng mat mengmengna, topical sermon, leh deih teng suktuahna hi. (2) Laisiangtho mun pawlkhat tungtawn a thulu kaihkhiatna, textual sermon, leh a sung thute ahi banga zonna leh kaihkhopna hi. (3) Laisiangtho mun pawlkhat a banban a sut ciatciatna hi in, exegesis, Laisiangtho kammal khempeuh ahi banga kantelna leh telkhehna hi. (4) Laisiangtho sunga mimal khat nuntakna tungtawn a thuhilhna, personal character, hi in, Noah, Abraham, Moses, David, Paul leh a dangdangte nuntak zia tawh kizui a thuhilhna hi. Thu i hilh ciangin kidop ding leh kigin ding tampi om a, i sim Laisiangtho mun zong limtak a theih ding, a nung a ma leh a deihna tel ding kisam hi. Thungetna tawh kipat ding hi. human condition.explanation: Mihing dinmun. Pasian in mihingte hong it mahmah napi mawhna in hong kikhensak a, midik kimlai mawhnei kisuak hi. Mawhna hangin Pasian gal kisuak hi.

human nature.explanation: Mihing hihna. Pasian in mihingte ama lim leh mel sunin hong bawl hi. Ahi zongin mihingte in Pasian lim leh mel kitheilo in zong kimu ngeilo hi. Mihing pen a kimu thei leh a kimu theilo namnih gawm in Pasian in piangsak hi. Mihing i cih in pumpi, body, lungsim, soul, kha, spirit hi. Mi khat pen lungsim, kha leh pumpi kigawmna hi. Pasian in ama lim leh mel sunin mihingte hong bawl hi (imago Dei). Mihingte leitung ah eima ut banga kipiang hilo in hong piangsak khat, Pasian, a om manin leitung ah kipiang in, ki-om hi.

humanism (secular).explanation: Mihing pilna tungah kingakna. Mihingte a thupi pen mun ah kikoih hun hi a, Pawlpi Lutang ahi Augustine leh Jerome a kipan a dangnal mite genkhiatna tawh hong piangkhia updan khat hi. Mihing thupina a lamsangte in Pasian thu phawklo in leitung vai leh leitung thu tawh ngaihsun khawm, a piangthakte in Laisiangtho hilhna tungah kinga in, Hebru leh Greek tawh Laisiangtho sitphatphat dingin gel uhhi. Mihing a thupisakte in Pasian thu laigil nawlkhin hi. Mihingte kithupi ngaihsutna in Pasian langdona leh Pasian thu nawlkhinna suak hi.

humanity, origin of.explanation: Mihing kipatna. Tapidaw upna ah mihing pen Pasian hu leh leivui pan kipan hi. Pasian in amah tawh kisun in hong bawl hi. A piansaksate sung pan a thupi pen mihing hi. Mihingte masuan ding zong Pasian in sehkholhsa in nei hi. Vantung gam tung ding leh hell tung ding zong Pasian in sehkhol hi. Mihingte in kipatna nei ahih manin hun khat ciangin beina tung ding hi.

Calvin in Pasian vangliatna, Pasian teeltuamna leh Pasian hehpihna a bulphuh hangin lungdamna thu tangko ding nawlkhin ngeilo hi. Hyper-Calvinism in Pasian in hotkhiatna ngah ding mite leitung pianma in hong teeltuam khinzo ahih manin lungdamna thu tangko ding kisam nawnlo hi. Pasian teeltuam mite in hun khat ciangin Pasian kiang zuankik ding ahih manin lungdamna thu pulak ding kisam lo hi, ci hi. Ahi zongin Calvin in teeltuamna a paksak hangin lungdamna thu tangko ding nawlkhin ngeilo in a omna peuh ah gupna thu genkhia den hi. Hun a ngahsim in laibu zong gelh den hi. Teeltuamna leh hotkhiatna thu genkhiat ding kitukkalhna omlo hi. Zeisu in lungdamna thu tangko ding hong sawl in paikhia un hong ci ahih manin Hyper-Calvinism, gupna thu genkhiat kullo, pen luangkheng hi (Mt.28:19-20; Jn.20:21; Sawl.1:8).

Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian in Pasian pianngei a kikim in nei a, neuzaw leh lianzaw cih ding omlo hi. Pa in na khempeuh a theih bangin Tapa leh Khasiangtho in zong na khempeuh thei uhhi. Tua hangin Laisiangtho sungah khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo hi. Pasian pen thumaan ahih manin Laisiangtho sungah zong khialhna om theilo in thumaan bek om hi. Laimal khempeuh leh laibu khempeuh Pasian humopna tawh kigelh hi. Piancilna pan Kilaakna sungah khialhna omlo in a vekpi in Pasian kammal hi. Laisiangtho in a nunung bel Pasian kilaakna hi.

inspiration, conceptual.explanation: Ngaihsutna bek humop. Laisiangtho gelhte ngaihsutna bek Pasian humop hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho gelhte tungah tua ngaihsutna pia in, a gelhte in amau theih danin gelhkhia hi. Tua hangin Laisiangtho sungah khialhna om thei hi.

inspiration, dynamic.explanation: Pawlkhat bek humop. Khasiangtho in Laisiangtho gelhte uk in, laigelhte in zong amau ut bangin gelh a, Laisiangtho khial thei hi. Hih pen Laisiangtho mun pawlkhat bek humop hi, Partial Inspiration, cih tawh kibang hi.

inspiration, natural.explanation: Ama thu a humop. Laisiangtho pen a cituam phadiak a Khasiangtho makaihna tawh kigelh hilo in, Laisiangtho gelhte in amau pilna leh siamna zui in gelh a, tua tungtawn in laibu hoih hong piangkhia hi.

inspiration, partial.explanation: Pawlkhat bek humop. Laisiangtho bu buppi Pasian humop hilo in, mun pawlkhat bek Pasian humop hi. Pasian lamlahna pen Pasian humopte tungtawn in kingah a, mihingte theihna tawh kigelhte tungtawn in tangthu leh thu tuamtuam kitheihlawh hi. Tua hangin Laisiangtho khial thei hi.

inspiration, verbal plenary.explanation: Laimal khempeuh leh laibu khempeuh humop. Laisiangtho sunga om laimal leh kammal khempeuh (verbal) Pasian humopna tawh kigelh in, laibu khempeuh, bu 66, (plenary) in Pasian humopna tawh kigelh hi. Hih in piangthakte upna laigil hi napi, upna pengte in sang zolo in Laisiangtho sungah Pasian kammal kihel hi, ‘The Bible contains the Word of God’ ci hi.

Ama hangin pasal no kum 2 nuaisiah khempeuh in thahna thuak hi. A neutung a kipan nu leh pa huh hi. Judahte ngeina khempeuh zui hi. Zeisu in kiniamkhiatna tawh hong suak in, kiniamkhiatna tawh nasem a, a nungzuite khe silsak in, midangte na a sepsak dingin hong pai hi. Zeisu in ama metna ding zonglo in mihingte suahtakna dingin nasem hi. Zeisu in midangte it in, cinate damsak in a sisa nangawn thokiksak in, gilkialte anvak in a cimawhte huh hi. Pa Pasian gelna banga nasep hong kipat ciangin bawlsiatna thuak in, ama pumpi kipia in sihna tawh vai khempeuh zosiang hi. Sihna zo in thokik a, vantung ah kahto hi.

Mun khempeuh ah Pasian ompihna kicing ding ahih manin dahna leh kahna om theilo ding hi (Klkna.21:22). Zeisu maitang kimu ding hi (Klkna.22:4). Zeisu pen ahi bangin i mu ding hi (1Jn.3:2). Hih khuapi in Pasian ukna khuapi hi (Heb.12:28); mopawi bangin nopci ding hi (Klkna.19:7). I ngah ding nuntakna sungah Pasian kamciam khempeuh kicing ding hi. limited atonement.explanation: A kiciangtan kithoihna. Piangthakte sungah kithoihna thu updan nam nih om hi. Khat in hotkhiatna pen kiciangtan in Pasian teeltuamte a ding bek in kicing hi, ci a, kimkhat in Zeisu hotkhiatna pen mi khempeuh a ding hi in, mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna ngah ding ci hi. Zeisu sihna pen kuate a dingin si hiam cih ngaihsutna thupi mahmah khat om hi. Thoihdamna, Zeisu in sihna hong thuakna, pen kuate a ding hiam cih leh Pasian teeltuamna ngahte a ding bek in mannei hi (Rom 8:32; 2Kor.5:14-15; Jn.10:11; Efe.5:25). Hih pen Laisiangtho tawh kituak hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ahi Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in hotkhiatna ah pangkhawm uhhi. Pa Pasian in leitung pianma in hotkhiatna ngah dingte sehkholhsa leh teeltuamsa in nei a, Zeisu mihing banga hong pai ciangin Pasian teeltuamte in hotkhiatna a ngahna dingin sihna hong thuak in, Khasiangtho in Pa Pasian teeltuamte leh Zeisu hotkhiatsa mite lungsim ah upna hong guan in, tua panin a bucing hotkhiatna, a bucing kithoihna leh mawhneite thoihdamna hong piang hi (Efe.1:4-13). Tua ahih manin kithoihna pen kiciangtan hi. Zeisu in singkhuam tungah mihingte a dingin si hi, cih pen nial theih hilo hi. Mawhneite hotkhiatna dingin Zeisu in sihna thuak hi, cihzong nial theih hilo hi. Ahi zongin kuate tungah gahsuah hiam cih ciangin Zeisu hong thoihdamna pen Pasian teeltuamna ngahte a ding bek in mannei hi. Hih pen John Calvin, Reformed theologian, upna leh hilhna sungah a thupi mahmah khat hi napi, Arminianism in Zeisu sihna leh hotkhiatna pen mi khempeuh a ding hi a, Pasian in kuamah teeltuam neilo in, kuamah hell khuksung tungsak lo ding hi, ci hi.

lord’s prayer.explanation: Topa thungetna. Zeisu in nungzuite leh thuzuite tungah hong hilh thunget zia hi (Mt.6:9-13). Pasian pen ‘Pa’ banga hopih ding hi.

lord’s supper.explanation: Nekkhawm. Zeisu in thuzuite tungah hong sawl nihte sungah khat hi (Mt.26:26-29). Hehpihna hun, pawlpi hun sunga kipia hi in, Zeisu hong pai masak leh paikikna, rapture, kikal sunga kizang ding hi. Hih in Zeisu hong paikik dinga, hong paikik nailo cihna hi. Nekkhawm pen Zeisu in hong sawl ahih manin zuih ding hi. A kitamzan moh in Zeisu pumpi lahna hi. Lenggah tui in Zeisu sisan lahna hi. Nekkhawm in Zeisu hong hotkhiat lungdamna, mawhneite tang dinga sihna hong thuakna, kiciamna thak, Khazih leh mite kigawmkhawm, pawlpi sungah thuzuite kithutuahna lak hi. Nekkhawm thu ah updan tuamtuam om hi. RC in siampite in thupha a piakkhit ciangin moh pen Zeisu pumpi in kilaih a, lenggah tui pen Zeisu sisan tawh kilaih hi (transubstantiation), ci hi. Lutheran a kici Luther upna leh hilhna tunga kinga thuzui pawlkhat in Zeisu pumpi leh sisan tawh kilaih hi cilo in, siampite in thupha a piak zawh ciangin moh sungah Zeisu pumpi kihel in, lenggah tui sungah Zeisu sisan kihel hi (consubstantiation), ci hi. Reformed a kicite upna ah nekkhawm pen Pasian in sep leh bawl dinga hong sawl ahih manin thupi mahmah a, nekkhawm tungtawn in kha thupha kisang in, khalam thupha om hi, ci hi. Thupi ahih manin Zeisu in hong sawl hi. Nekkhawm thu ah mi tampite kithukim mahmahna khat in phawkna tawh sepna hi. Hih pen Zwingli upna hi a, tui a kiphumte in diksa hi. Nekkhawm a kihel dingte in Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphumte hi dinga, a mawhna kisittel masa ding hi. Nekkhawm ah Pasian itna leh hehpihna kiphawk thak ahih manin khalam thupha om takpi hi.

lutheranism.explanation: Luther updan. Martin Luther upna leh hilhna hi in, kum zalom 16 kim a hong piangkhia Langpangte upna paidan khat hi. Lutheranism cih pen Luther upna leh hilhna hi a, a pankhia Luther hi in (1483-1546), RC phungzi leh Pasian thu thuk lamsang a thei mahmah khat hi. Upna bek tawh Pasian mai ah dikna kingah hi, cih tawh piangthak a upna thak, muhna thak leh kalsuanna thak, upna puahphatna thak, hong patkhiat ciangin mawhsakna tampi thuak hi. A omna pawlpi upna maanlo hi cih lahna dingin thu (95) gelhkhia in tua in RC hehsak mahmah hi. Pawlpi Kipuahphatna, Reformation, pen thusia hilo napi pawlpi upna kilamdang lua ahih manin RC in Luther leh a pawlte Langpangte, Protestants, cih minpia hi. Luther in Laisiangtho thupina leh Pasian kammal bek a thupi pen ahihna gen in, mawhneite in upna hangin Pasian hehpihna bek tawh dikkisakna kingahna zong limgen a, Pasian thu a um khempeuh in Pasian ta bek hilo in Pasian siampi za ngah in, Zeisu in zuih leh sep dinga hong thupiak nam nih: Tuiphumna leh Nekkhawm, RC upna zungpi 7 sung pan hemkhia in, upna thak leh paidan thak khat hong piangkhia a tua pen Lutheranism kici hi.

natural contingency.explanation: Pianpih pianngei. Reinhold Niebuhr (1892-1971) hilhna ah mihing in kiciangtanna tawh kidim ahih manin nuntakna ah bitna ngahlo banah Pasian tungah kingak ding kisam niloh hi.

natural law.explanation: A ngeina. Pasian in mihingte zuih leh theih dinga hong piak nuntak ziate hi. Sia leh pha khentel theihna in Pasian hong piak hehpihna thupha khat hi. Mihingte bek hilo in Pasian in ganhingte dongin pianpih pilna leh theihna pia hi.

natural process.explanation: Pianpih tawndan. Na khempeuh ama dan leh nam tawh kizui in a cil a kipan piang hi.

natural religion.explanation: Pianpih biakna. I pianna mun leh gam tawh kizui a eite biakna leh updan tuamtuamte hi in, a nungta Pasian theihna tawh kizopna omlo hi. Biakna in a vanglian mahmah Pasian omna donlo hi. Biakna pen mihingte patkhiat hi.

natural revelation.explanation: Piansakte tawh kilaakna. Pasian in ama hoihsakna bangin mihingte tungah a piansaksa nate tawh hong kilang hi. Hih piansaksa nate tawh Pasian maan kithei hi, a ci zong om hi. Ahi zongin upna bek tawh, Pasian kammal bek tawh, Pasian maan kithei a ci zong om hi. Vantung, leitung leh a sunga omte in Pasian kilaakna hi. Ahi zongin mihingte in Pasian bawlsa ahih lam theilo in ama thu a piangtawm hi, natural, cihsan hi.

natural righteousness.explanation: Pianpih dikna. Pasian in Adam tungah pianpih dikna leh sianthona pia hi. Adam in pianpih dikna nei napi mawhna in tua sianthona leh dikna susia hi.

natural rights.explanation: Pianpih hamphatna. Mihing in pianpih dikna leh hoihna nei hi. Mihingte tungah ukna, ngaihsut theihna, phuahtawm theihna leh sep theihna om hi.

natural theology.explanation: Khuak theihna. Laisiangtho tungah kingalo a mihing khuak theihna tawh tapidaw upnate ngaihsutna, upna leh hilhkikna hi in, theihna maan ngah zolo hi. Khuak theihna tawh Pasian omna, vantung, leitung leh a sunga om nate pianna i kan niloh hangin theihna maan kingah zolo a, a kipiangsak nate in Pasian pianngei kiteltak in hong hilh theilo ahih manin Pasian maan theihna kingah zolo hi. Mihingte khuak theihna tawh Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian thu, Zeisu in Pasian ahihna leh mihing ahihna banah Mary sung pan Zeisu hong suahkhiatna thu, upna hangin hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna, Laisiangtho in Pasian humopna tawh kigelh in khialhna leh kitukkalhna a omlohna, mawhna hanga Pasian tawh kikhenna hanga sihna i thuakna, Zeisu hong paikikna ding thute kitel zolo hi. Laisiangtho ahi banga i up masiah mihing khuak in theihna maan hong tun zolo hi.

nature, divine.explanation: Pasian pianngei. Pasian pianngei hi. Zeisu in Pasian pianngei nei hi. Khasiangtho in Pasian pianngei nei hi. Mihingte tungah Pasian pianngei omlo in, mawhnei pianngei om hi. Na khempeuh hih theihna, mun khempeuh ah om theihna, na khempeuh theihna, kikhel ngeilohna cihte Pasian bek in nei hi. Itna, hehpihna, lainatna leh sianthona in Pasian leh mite neihkhop theih pianngei hi.

nature, human.explanation: Mihing pianngei. Mihingte pen Pasian in amah tawh a kisun in hong bawl hi. Sihna pen mawhna thaman hi in, mihingte pianpih ngeina hilo hi. Tua hangin mi khempeuh in sihna leh sih ding kihta hi. Pasian siangtho ahih manin mihing pianngei zong sianthona mah hi a, ahi zongin mawhna in Pasian tawh hong kikhensak hi. Mihingte sianthona kiciangtan hi. Pasian lim leh mel sun mihingte ihih manin a bawlsa leh a piansaksa nate sung pan a sang pen leh a thupi pen mihingte hi. Zeisu in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah khat leh a nihnapa hi. Pasian pianngei leh mihing pianngei neikhawm a, a kibanglo pianngei nih neikhawm hi. Khasiangtho in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah khat leh a thumnapa hi. Pasian pianngei leh mihing pianngei neikhawm hi. Khasiangtho pen mi bangin kigen hi. Khasiangtho in mit tawh kimu theilo napi, mihing bangin heh thei, dah thei leh kimitsak thei a, kikhasiasak thei hi.

Zeisu pen Pasian ahihna um napi, Mary sung pan hong suahkhiatna umlo leuleu hi. Hih updan pen upna pengte tawh kilamdang lualo hi.

(3) Laisiangtho pen Pasian kammal hong suak in mihingte in nisim in kitangko hi. (4) Pasian lim leh mel i sutna pen pumpi hilo in ngaihsutna bek hi. (5) Pasian mai ah mihingte mawhcipna pen Zeisu huhna leh Pasian sepna bek tawh kizosiang thei ding hi.

order of salvation (ordo salutis).explanation: Hotkhiatna hong luankhiat zia. Mawhnei mihingte tungah Pasian itna leh Zeisu hotkhiatna hong tunzia genna hi. Hotkhiatna hong paizia tangpi thukimna khat om a, tua pen sapna, thaksuahsakna, pianthakna, dikkisakna, Khazih tawh kigawmna, Pasian goluahna hi in, hotkhiatna i ngah ciangin hih thuphate kingah hi. Reformedte in hih bangin pom napi, Arminiante in sang zolo hi. Reformedte upna ah hotkhiatna pen Pasian in mihingte leitung pianma pek a hong teeltuamna tungah kinga in Pasian vangliatna tungah kingasak hi. Arminiante upna ah previnient grace kici khat om in hih pen mi khempeuh tungah Pasian hehpihna kicing cihna leh eima ut hun peuh teh kipiangthak thei in Pasian thu kipom thei cihna hi. Hotkhiatna hong pianzia pen i pawlpi zui in updan kilamdang hi. Laisiangtho sungah hotkhiatna hong pianzia cih kammal zong omlo ahih manin updan tuamtuam a om thei ding mah hi. Upna a masak om in, kisikkikna a masak zong om in, pianthakna a masak zong om a, updan kilamdang hi. Paul in hotkhiatna pen Pasian theihkholhna tungah kinga hi. Pasian in a theihkholhte a ding sehkholhsa in nei hi. Pasian in a sehkholhsa mite sam hi. Pasian in a sapte diksak hi. A diksakte Pasian in minthangsak hi, ci hi (Rom 8:29-30).

ordinances.explanation: Pawlpi zuih ding thunih. Cituamna lahna dinga Zeisu in pawlpi tungah sep leh bawl dinga hong sawl lim nihte hi. Khat pen Tuiphumna hi in, a dang khat pen Nekkhawm hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna ding hilo in upna tawh Pasian ta suahna lahna hi. RC in sacraments cih kammal tawh upna zungpi 7 nei a, hihte pen hotkhiatna ngahna dingin zui uhhi. Tuiphumna pen Zeisu tawh sihkhopna leh sihna pan thawhkikna, Pasian mite tawh kipumkhatna banah Pasian tawh kipumkhatna lahna hi. A piangthakte in Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphum ding hi (Mt.28:19-20). Hih in Zeisu thupiak hi. Nekkhawm, Topa Nitak Ankuang, pen updan tuamtuam om hi. Zeisu in na bawl un hong ci ahih manin bawl ding hi. RC upna ah siampite in moh leh lenggah tui thupha a piakkhit ciangin Zeisu pumpi leh sisan tawh kilaih hi (transubstantiation). Lutherante upna ah siampite in moh leh lenggah tui thupha a piakkhit ciangin Zeisu pumpi leh sisan kihel hi (consubstantiation). Reformedte in nekkhawm ah khalam thupha om ci hi. Tui kiphumte in Zeisu hong sepsaksa thute phawkna ciang tawh kibawl hi. Hih pen Zwingli tung pan kiluahsuk hi. Nekkhawm i zat ciangin Pasian itna leh Zeisu thuakna kiphawk ahih manin Khalam thupha om takpi cih kimu hi.

Zeisu in ama nuntakna pia in mite leh Pasian kilemna dingin nasem hi. Anglican pawlpi sungah kidona leh langpanna hong piang in, siampite bek in thuneih ding deihlo in Laisiangtho tawh kituak a kalsuanna leh biakna, siampite cih bangbang zuilo a Laisiangtho hilh banga gamtatna bek zuih ding hi, cih deihna om hi. Hih sianthona, Laisiangtho bek bulphuh a kalsuan ding, a lunggulhte in pawlpi sung sianthosak ding hanciam uhhi. Amaute in, sianthona a deihte, John Calvin thuhilhna siksan in pawlpi sungah upate vaihawmna thupisak ding, mite deihna banga kalsuan ding leh biakna leh khalam kipuahphat ding hanciam uhhi. Pawlpi in dinmun maan ah om a Laisiangtho bek tawh kalsuan ding leh Pasian minthangsak ding kiplet hi.

resurrection of believers.explanation: Midikte thawhkikna. Zeisu in sihna zo a hansung pan a thawhkik bangin Pasian thu a um taktakte zong ni khat ni ciangin thokik ding hi. Thawhkikna in Pasian vangliatna hi. Thawhkikna in kihehnepna sungah a sang pen hi. Thawhkikna in tapidaw upna cituamna leh thupina hi. Sihna zo a thawhkikna in biakna dangte tawh kilamdanna khat hi. Thawhkikna in thaman sanna ding leh minthanna mun lutna hi.

resurrection of christ.explanation: Khazih thawhkikna. Zeisu in hansung pan ni thum khit teh thokik hi. Zeisu pen a pumpi leh a kha kikhen banah han sitna suangpi zong kilikkhia hi. Zeisu in vanglianpi tawh thokik in minthanna pumpi tawh nungta hi. Thawhkikna ah Pa Pasian (Sawl.2:24), Tapa Zeisu (Jn.10:17-18) leh Khasiangtho (Rom 8:11) kihel hi. Zeisu thawhkikna in Pasian ahihna lak hi. Zeisu in mihing banga hong om hangin Pasian hihna bei tuanlo hi.

resurrection of the dead.explanation: Misite thawhkikna. A tawpna pen thukhenna a omma in mi khempeuh sihna pan kithokik ding hi. Tokhom Kang Mai a thukhenna in a nunung bel thukhenna hi in Pasian thu a umlote a ding hi.

resurrection of unbelievers.explanation: Piangthaklote thawhkikna. Piancil a kipan leitung bei donga Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh zong hun khat ciangin thokik dinga Zeisu in thukhen ding hi. Hih pen Tokhom Kang Mai ah thukhenna hi in, tua panin meilipi sungah kikhia dinga hehpihna cihbang om nawnlo ding hi. Leitung ah Zeisu tawh a kisukha lo mi tampi om a, ahi zongin hih thukhenna ah Zeisu leh a piangthak lo khempeuh kitalsik ding hi.

resurrection, first.explanation: Thawhkikna masa. Kum 1000 maanna ma in Zeisu hong paikik ding cih a umte in Kilaakna 20:5 pen Khazih a umte thawhkikna ci uhhi. Thawhkikna nihna pen Pasian thu a umlote thawhkikna ci hi.

revelation, anthropic.explanation: Mi banga kilaakna. Pasian in mi bangin kilaak hi. Mi tawh a kibang in Pasian kilaak hi.

revelation, biblical.explanation: Laisiangtho tungtawn a kilaakna. Pasian in Laisiangtho tungtawn in eite tungah hong kilaak in thu hong gen hi. Laisiangtho, Thukhun Lui leh Thak, in Pasian omna leh Pasian thupina hong hilh banah eite dinmun maan zong hong hilh hi.

revelation, divine.explanation: Pasian kilaakna. Mihingte theih dingin Pasian in kilaakna hong bawl hi. Pasian in theih ding leh up ding a ut Pasian hi in, muh ding a deihlo Pasian hi.

revelation, final.explanation: A nunung bel kilaakna. Zeisu leh Laisiangtho tawh mihingte tungah hong kilaakna in a nunung bel Pasian kilaakna hi (Heb.1:1-4). Thuzuite theih dinga kilawm khempeuh Laisiangtho tawh Pasian in hong hilh hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian lungsim leh Pasian deihna khempeuh hong hilh hi. Laisiangtho in a nunung bel Pasian kilaakna hi in, thusuak leh mailam thu ding genkholhna tuamtuamte kisamlo hi. I deihna khempeuh Zeisu sung leh Laisiangtho sungah kicing hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho tawh thu hong hilh hi.

revelation, general.explanation: A zaipi a kilaakna. Vantung, leitung leh a sunga om nate in Pasian omna hong lak hi (Late 19:1; Rom 1:19). A piangsak a om manin nate piang in, muh theih leh muh theihlohte dongin om hi. Na khempeuh Pasian piansak hi a, tua in ama hong kilaakna nam khat hi (Pian.1:1).

revelation, indirect.explanation: Kilaakna ciaptehna. Karl Barth upna ah Laisiangtho pen Pasian kilaakna hilo in kilaakna ciaptehna leh kilaakna tetti hi.

revelation, model of.explanation: Kilaak zia. Pasian in mihingte tungah lampi tuamtuam tawh hong kilaak hi. Ahi zongin mihingte in bang cibang in Pasian thu thei, tel, mu leh Pasian deihna thei cih pen a tuampi hi. A cituam kilaakna tungtawn a theihna bek tawh Pasian maan leh ei leh ei kitheihna piang hi.

revelation, natural.explanation: Piansakte tawh kilaakna. Pasian in a piansaksa vantung, leitung leh a sunga om nate tawh hong kilaak hi. General revelation tawh kibang hi.

revelation, nonpropositional view of.explanation: Pasian mahmah kilaakkhia. Kilaakna in Pasian patkhiat leh Pasian mahmah hong kilaakkhiatna hi a, phuahtawm hilo hi. Kilaakna pen Pasian patkhiat hi.

revelation, progressive.explanation: A kizomsuak kilaakna. Laisiangtho tawh Pasian kilaakna in a nung a piangsa thute leh mailam ah hong piang ding thute hong hilh ahih manin Pasian kilaakna in a kizom paisuak hi.

revelation, signs of.explanation: Kilaak ziate. Karl Barth hilhna ah Pasian kilaakna pen mite in Pasian a tuahkhakna hi. Pasian in lim tuamtuam tawh mite tungah hong kilang a tuate sungah a thupi pen kilaakna in Laisiangtho hi.

revelation, special.explanation: A cituam kilaakna. Pasian in mihingte tungah hong kilaakna nam nih sung pan khat hi a, a tangzaipi a kilaakna ahi Piansakna tawh kilaakna sangin khauhpai zaw a, Zeisu leh Laisiangtho tawh Pasian in thu hong genna hi. Pasian piansak vantung, leitung leh a sunga om nate in Pasian omna leh Pasian itna kiteltak in lak theilo ahih manin a cituam kilaakna kisam a, Pasian in a Tapa Zeisu leh Laisiangtho tawh a cituam mahmah in hong kilaak hi. Zeisu hangin Pasian maan kithei banah ei leh ei kitheihna piang hi. Laisiangtho tungtawn in Pasian lungsim, Pasian maan leh Pasian deihna kithei hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho tawh eite hong hopih in thu hong gen hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian lungsim hong lak hi. Laisiangtho pualam ah Pasian deihna i theihna ding omlo hi. Mang, vision, thusuak, aisanna cihte leh tapidawte kizopna om nawnlo hi.

revivalism.explanation: Khanlawhna. Pawlpi puahphatna tawh hong tonkhawm khanlawhna leh pawlpi sungah pianthakna thu tawh kalsuanna hi. Hih updan in mihingte theihna tungtawn in Pasian itna leh mihingte mawhcipna kithei a, hih nihte kigawmna panin pianthakna leh khanlawhna kingah hi. A khanglo pawlpi in (1) Pasian kammal tungah dingin Pasian tawh kizopna hoih nei in, mawhnate kisikkikna tawh Pasian kiang zuan tawntung hi. (2) Saptuam ah khanlawhna a omna dingin Pasian kiangah khanlawhna meikuang ngen niloh hi. (3) Khanlawhna a kizopsuakna dingin midangte tungah Pasian itna leh lungdamna thu tangko kawikawi hi. (4) Pawlpi ah biakna leh phatna nei tawntung in nisim nuntakna ah sianthona leh Zeisu tawh kisutna hanciam in, lungdamna thugen hanciam semsem hi.

roman catholicism.explanation: RC upna. RC upna leh Langpangte upna sungah kilamdanna tampi om hi. RC in Laisiangtho leh pawlpi tangthute a kikim in sang hi. Ahi zongin Langpangte in Laisiangtho bek Pasian kammal in sang hi. Dikkisakna in mawh maina, suahthakna, sianthona huamsak a, Langpangte in dikkisakna pen kisuantakna pan suahtakna cih bang cianga sanna pen sang zolo hi. Upna zungpi 7 (seven sacraments) tungtawn in Pasian hehpihna kisang in, hotkhiatna zong kingah a, Langpangte in Pasian hehpihna tawh upna hangin dikkisakna leh nuntak tawntungna kingah hi. Pope tungah Zeisu in nasepna ding thuneihna khempeuh pia in, tuni a pope a kicite in zong Piter nasepte luah toto hi. Piter tungah thuneihna a kipiak bangin pope tungah thuneihna khempeuh om hi (Mt.16:18). Zeisu pen mihing kician khat hi in a kidem theilo Pasian pianngei khat zong nei hi. Nekkhawm pen siampite in moh leh lenggah tui thupha a piakkhit ciangin Zeisu pumpi leh sisan tawh kilaih pah hi (transubstantiation). RC in Zeisu phuhsa ahih manin thuneihna khempeuh nei a, siampite vaihawmna tawh kibawl pawlpi tangthu bute, biakpiakna tuamtuamte leh Laisiangthote pen thumaan hi in, Khazih tanga nasem siampite thuneihna kipsuak hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna dingin nekkhawm leh upna zungpi 7 sungah khat peuhmah zuih ding kisam a, na hoih sepna in gupkhiatna hong pia hi. Upna paipi 7 in: Tuiphumna, RC upna ka zui ding hi, cih kipsakna leh kiciamna, Nekkhawm, Mawhsutna, Kitenna, Kalsuanna kician leh Misite sathau nilhna hi. A tom theipen a kilakhia hi in, gelh ding tampi omlai hi.

sabbath/sabbatarianism.explanation: Ni sagihna/thukham zuihna. Piansakna ah ni sagihna hi in Pasian tawlngak ni leh ama mite a dingin a sianthosak ni hi. Sabbath ni in Israelte nasep khawl ding hi. Pasian in Sabbath ni siangthosak un ci a, Zeisu in zong Sabbath zui hi. Ahi zongin Zeisu in Sabbath ni in nalamdang tampi bawl hi. Thukhun Lui ah Sabbath zuih ding kigen a, Thukhun Thak ah Sabbath zuih ding kihemkhia hi. Sabbath pen thukham hi in, hong piang ding lim lahna hi a, a taktak pen Zeisu hi. Zeisu a neite in Sabbath, tawldamna, hotkhiatna, ngah hi.

sabellianism.explanation: Sabellius’ upna. Monarchianism tawh kibang a, Pasian khat bek om in, mimal thum tawh a hunzui in kilang hi. Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho omlo hi. Thukhun Lui ah Pasian pen Pa bangin kilang hi. Thukhun Thak ah Pasian pen Tapa bangin kilang hi. Tu hun ciangin Pasian pen Khasiangtho bangin kilang hi. Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho in mimal thum hilo in kilaakna nam thum, three modes, hi. Hih pen modalism zong kici hi. Pasian khat pen mel tuamtuam thum tawh kilang hi. Laisiangtho hilhna tawh kilehbulh ahih manin tanglai tapidaw hoihte in nial hi.

Arminianism zui a, nekkhawmte zanglo hi. Pawlpi mi khempeuh galkapte bangin uniform nei uhhi. Kha thu sangin mihingte kisapte thupi ngaihsut zaw uhhi.

salvation by baptism.explanation: Tuiphumna tawh hotkhiatna. Pianthakna leh upna kician neilopi a kumcin cianga tuiphumna in hotkhiatna hi. Tapidaw innkuan sunga khangkhia pawlkhat in upna tawh pianthakna bulphuhlo in sia leh pha theihna a nei khempeuh tuiphum hi.

salvation by faith.explanation: Upna tawh hotkhiatna. Upna tawh hotkhiatna kingah in sepna kihello hi. Abraham in sepna kihello in upna tawh dikna ngah hi. Upna in Pasian hehpihna tawh kingah hi. Pasian in upna hong piak ciangin upna kingah hi.

salvation by grace.explanation: Hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna. Langpangte upna laigil hi a, Pasian hehpihna bek tawh hotkhiatna kingah in, mawhna kol pan kisuakta hi. Pasian in a khawnkhong in hotkhiatna hong pia hi. Hih hotkhiatna in tawntung bitna hong pia hi.

salvation by observance of the law.headword: salvation by observance of the law
translations: Salvation by Observance of the Law
salvation by observance of the law.explanation: Thukham zuihna tawh hotkhiatna. Pasian hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna ngah ding ollua ahih manin thukham zuihna bek tawh a bucing hotkhiatna kingah ding hi. Sepna bek tawh dikna kingah hi.

salvation by works.explanation: Sepna tawh hotkhiatna. Hotkhiatna pen upna leh hehpihna tawh hilo in sepna bek tawh kingah hi. Saptuam masate sungah Pelagius in hih bangin hilhna maanlo hilh hi.

salvation from cultural influences.explanation: Ngeina pan suahtakna. Zeisu hotkhiatna in ngeina hoihlo leh khanglui upna tuamtuam pan suahtakna hi. Mihingte ngeina sungah Pasian thu tawh a kilehbulh tampi om hi. Zeisu hotkhiatna in kha bek hotkhiatna hilo in pupa ngeina sung pan hotkhiatna hi.

salvation from death.explanation: Sihna pan hotkhiatna. Hotkhiatna in sihna pan hotkhiatna hi. Sihna in mawhna thaman hi. Pasian tawh kikhenna in sihna hi. Pasian a umte in nuntak tawntungna ngah a, Pasian thu a umlo khempeuh in tawntung sihna thuak hi.

salvation from hell.explanation: Gawtmun pan hotkhiatna. Pasian in ama thu a umlote tunna ding gawtmun, meilipi, bawl hi. Zeisu in hih gawtmun pan hong honkhia hi.

salvation from satan.explanation: Satan khutsung pan hotkhiatna. Satan khutsung tungsa mawhnei leitung mite a honkhia dingin Zeisu hong pai in mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak hi. Zeisu in Satan khutsung pan hong honkhia hi. Hotkhiatna in Satan vangliatna pan suahtakna hi.

salvation from sin.explanation: Mawhna pan hotkhiatna. Adam hanga mawhna sung a tung mihingte a honkhia dingin Zeisu in singkhuam tungah sihna hong thuak hi. Mawhna khempeuh Zeisu in hong puaksak hi. Zeisu hangin i mawhna khempeuh maisiang hi. Mawhcipna pan dikna kingah hi.

salvation from the law.explanation: Thukham pan suahtakna. Pasian in mite hoihna dingin thukham pia hi. Ahi zongin thukham zuizo omlo hi. Zeisu in thukham kalhna khempeuh hong sepsak ahih manin eite sep ding leh zuih ding om nawnlo hi. Piangthakte in thukham pan suakta in hehpihna sung kitung hi.

salvation history.explanation: Hotkhiatna thu. Leitung mite mawhna pan a honkhia dinga Zeisu hong sihna thu upna panin mawhneite in Pasian hehna pan suakta in Pasian gam tung hi. Hotkhiatna in mihingte sep hilo in Pasian sep hi.

sola fide (faith alone).explanation: Upna bek. ‘Sola’ pen Latin lai hi in ‘bek’ cihna hi in, ‘Fide’ pen upna hi in, ‘Upna bek’ cihna hi. Martin Luther leh John Calvin tungtawn a Pawlpi Upna Kipuahphatna (Protestant Reformation) tawh hong piangkhia upna thak leh thugil pen khat hi. Upna bek tawh mawhnei khat in Pasian mai ah dikna ngah thei in (Rom 1:17; Gal.3:11), Pasian muhna ah siangtho thei hi. I kha in hotkhiatna a ngahna dingin pawlpi in bangmah hong sepsak theilo banah, mihingte hanciamna in Pasian mai ah dikna hong pia theilo hi (Rom 5:1-2).

sola gratia (grace alone).explanation: Hehpihna bek. Sola Fide mah bangin Sola Gratia zong Martin Luther leh John Calvin tungtawn a Pawlpi Upna Kipuahphatna (Protestant Reformation) tawh hong piangkhia upna thak leh thugil pen khat hi in, ‘Hehpihna bek’ cihna hi. Mawhnei khat in Pasian a up theihna pen ama khensatna hilo in Pasian hehpihna hang bek hi a, Pasian hehpihna bek tawh mawhnei kimlai Pasian mai ah dikna leh sianthona kingah hi. Pasian hehpihna bek tawh upna, dikna leh tawntung bitna kingah hi. Gamtat hoihna leh pawlpi thukhunte in hotkhiatna hong pia theilo hi. Pasian hehpihna tawh ngah dinga kilawmlo kha hotkhiatna kingah hi (Efe.2:8-9).

sola scriptura (scripture alone).explanation: Laisiangtho bek. Martin Luther leh John Calvin tungtawn a Pawlpi Upna Kipuahphatna (Protestant Reformation) tawh hong piangkhia upna thak leh thugil pen khat hi in, ‘Laisiangtho bek Pasian Kammal hi’ cihna hi. Laisiangtho pen Pasian Kammal hi in, khialhna omlo in thuzuite lutang hi in, na khempeuh Laisiangtho tawh khinkhai ding hi. Saptuam lutang pen Pasian nasem khat peuh hilo in, Laisiangtho bek saptuam lutang hi cih leh saptuam sangin Pasian Kammal vanglian zaw hi, cihna hi phadiak hi (Heb.1:1-4). Laisiangtho bek Pasian kammal ahih manin hih laibu tawh Pasian in eite tungah thu hong gen in hong kilaak hi. Laisiangtho bek tawh Pasian maan kithei hi.

Upna tang in Pasian maan theihna, upna hangin hehpihna tawh dikkisakna ngahna, sihnung cianga paina ding khamuanna leh Zeisu hong paikik ding cih lametna tawh nuntakna banah nisim a sianthona tawh kalsuanna hi. Paul in a cidam huai thuhilhna na gen hi (2Tim.4:3; Titu.1:9). A cidam huai thuhilhna in siangtho nuntakna lahkhiat ding hi. Pasian thu leh Laisiangtho thute ahi banga upna leh hilhna pen upna tang hi.
