spiration.explanation: Kipatna. Khasiangtho pen Pa leh Tapa kiang pan kipan hi. Tapidaw masate sungah Khasiangtho hong paina thu ah buaina om hi. Khasiangtho pen Pa leh Tapa gelna bangin hong pai hi. Eternal procession ah en in.

spirit.explanation: hu lungsim kha dawi khuasia dawino sikha hang sanna thalawpna lungsim puak om dan athupi pen makai mi akhiatna aman athu laigil cihnop na lungsim phawkna zuu zuu cil khauh thuzawh na

spirit of adoption.explanation: Ta hihna. Khasiangtho nasepna tawh upna hangin Pasian ta hong suaksak hi. Khasiangtho hangin Pasian tawh kilemna kingah hi (Rom 8:15).

spirit of the world.explanation: Leitung kha. Pasian Kha makaihna tungah kinga lo a leitung pilna leh siamna tawh kalsuanna hi (1Kor.2:12).

spirit of truth.explanation: Thumaan. Khasiangtho in thuzuite ama thumaan leh thutak sungah hong makaih hi (Jn.14:17).

spirit of wisdom.explanation: Pilna. Pasian in thuzuite tungah ama hehpihna tawh hong piak pilna, theihna leh siamna hi (Efe.1:17).

spirit, fruit of the.explanation: Khasiangtho gah. Paul in Khasiangtho gah 9 hong gen hi (Gal.5:22-23).

spirit, outpouring of the.explanation: Kha kibuakna. Pentecost Ni a Jerusalem ah Khasiangtho kibuakna leh nasepna hi (Joel 2:28).

spirit, personality of the.explanation: Khasiangtho mimal hihna. Khasiangtho in mihing pianngei nei hi. Khasiangtho in Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah khat leh a thumnapa hi. Khasiangtho in Pasian pianngei a dimin nei hi.

spirit, to seal with the.explanation: Pasian ompihna. Pasian in amah a itte tungah Khasiangtho pia in ompih tawntung hi. Thuzuite in Pasian innkuanpih leh Pasian neihsa hi (2Kor.1:22).

spirit, witness of the.explanation: Khasiangtho tetti panna. Piangthakte lungsim ah Khasiangtho in Pasian ta ihihna tetti pang hi.

spirit, work of the.explanation: Khasiangtho nasep. Khasiangtho in vantung, leitung leh a sunga om na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian, pianthakna hong pia Pasian leh thuzuite hong kem Pasian hi (Rom 8:9-30).

spirit-filled.explanation: Kha tawh kidim. Pasian thu in a uk leh a makaih nuntakna in Kha tawh kidimna hi (Efe.5:18).

spiritism.explanation: Kha dan bek thupisak. Leitung vai leh na khempeuh ah kha dan bekbek paksak a, kha thu upna leh thupisakna hi. Laisiangtho thute pan pialna hi.

spiritless.explanation: alungsim aneu lungsim thahat na-thalawpna a -omlo

spiritual.explanation: kha tawh kisai mihing hihtheihloh na lamdang tawh kisai

spiritual blessings.explanation: Khalam thuphate. Mi khat a pianthak ciangin Khalam thupha tampi sang hi. Upna, thaksuahna, dikkisakna, sianthona, goluahna, Khasiangtho tendenna leh tawntung bitna cihte hi in, mihing hanciamna tawh kingah theilo hi. Khalam thuphate sum tawh kilei theilo banah thalawh theih hilo hi.

spiritual body.explanation: Kha pumpi. Sihna pan a thokik pumpi in kha pumpi hi. A thokik pumpi in si theilo leh muat theilo hi.

spiritual death.explanation: Kha sihna. Mawhna thaman in sihna hi. Sihna in kikhenna hi. Kha sihna in tawntung sihna hi. A piangthak lote kha si hi. Sihna sungah a kihtak huai bel kha sihna hi.

spiritual desertion.explanation: Khalam taisanna. Kum zalom 17 hun a English Puritante upna ah Pasian pen thuzuite tawh omkhawm tawntunglo in kigamla hi, ci hi.

spiritual food.explanation: Kha-an. Laisiangtho in tapidawte kha-an hi. Pumpi a ding an i nek bangin khalam khantohna dingin kha-an nek ding kisam hi. Laisiangtho hoihtak a i sim keileh i khalam khantoh dan maanlo hi. Zeisu tawh kisun a nuntak theihna dingin Laisiangtho limtak a sim ding hi.

spiritual formation.explanation: Khasung kilamna. Pianthak zawh ciangin nisim in i upna lam ding kisam hi. Pasian deihna zuih masak ding leh ci leh sa deihna nial tawntung ding hi. Thungetna, Laisiangtho simna, phatna leh biakna a kipan piakkhiatna tawh i khalam nuntakna damdam a khansak ding hi. Nipi ni sim biakinn tunna in khasung kilamna ah manpha mahmah hi.

spiritual foundation.explanation: Kha nuntakna phungpi. Upna hangin hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna kingah hi. Tapidaw upna phungpi in Pasian hi. Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian kiang pan hotkhiatna kipan hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho tawh thuzuite hong hopih hi. Laisiangtho in a nunung pen Pasian kilaakna hi. Vantung gam tunna dingin Zeisu bek lampi hi.

spiritual gifts.explanation: Khasiangtho siamnate. Piangthakte tungah Khasiangtho in siamna a tuamciat hong pia in, tuate pen pawlpi kilambehna ding hi (1Kor.12,14; Efe.4:11-12). Pawlpi pianna dinga kizang deuh letsong pawlkhat om in, tuate beita a, a dang pawlkhat omlai hi. Piangthakte sungah Sawltakte hunlai mah bangin tuni in Khasiangtho letsongte kizang thei lai hi, a ci leh, beita hi, kisam nawnlo hi cih danin, kikhenna nam nih om hi. Pentecostalte (AG) leh Tuiphumte kithutuah lohna khat hi.

spiritual growth.explanation: Khalam khantohna. Khazih tawh kisutna ah nisim a khantohna hi. Khasiangtho in siatna leh mawhna ah hong makaih lo in lampi maan ah hong kha hi. Khazih sutna dingin thungetna, Laisiangtho simna leh lungdamna thu tangkona hanciam ding hi. Khalam khantohna dingin kha-an ahi Laisiangtho maanmaan a sim ding hi. It zawhna, mawhna maisak zawhna, phatna leh biakna, leh hehpih theihna cihte in khalam khantohna lim hi.

spiritual life.explanation: Khalam nuntakna. Upna hanga hehpihna tawh dikna ngahte in nisim in Khasiangtho kimakaihsak a nuntak ding hi. Khazih tawh kisun a nuntakna in tapidaw nuntakna ah a sang pen hi. Tapidaw nuntakna in midangte a dinga nuntakna hi.

spiritual presence of christ.explanation: Khazih kihelna. Nekkhawm i zat ciangin moh leh lenggah tui sungah Zeisu Kha, Pasian ompihna, kihel hi. Moh leh lenggah tui pen a mawkmawk hilo in Khazih ompihna lak hi. Khazih pumpi vantung ah om in, leitung ah Zeisu Nitak Ankuang ki-umkhawm a, hih thu nih pen Khasiangtho in hong gawmkhawm hi. Khasiangtho in vantung leh leitung gawmkhawm hi. Pawlpi ah Khazih pen a kha tawh hong tuaksuk hi. Hih upna in phawkna tawh sep ding thupisak in, Zeisu sisan leh pumpi suak takpi cih leh Zeisu sisan leh pumpi kihel cihte sanglo leuleu hi.

spiritual pride.explanation: Khalam kiphatsakna. Pasian in kiniamkhiatna deih in kiphatsakna deihlo hi. Pasian nasepna sungah kiniamkhiatna kisam in kiphatsakna kizang theilo hi. Pasian nasem khat in midangte sanga a thupizaw a kimuhna leh kiphatsakna in pukna kipatna hi. Kiphatsakna in Khasiangtho mei mitsak ahih manin khanlawhna meikuang kizom nawnlo hi.

spiritual warfare.explanation: Kha galdona. Tapidaw nuntakna in galdona hi. Thuzuite in Satan tawh nisim in kido hi. Nisim in i do ding gal om hi. Khalam galdona ah antang a thungetna leh Pasian kammal siksan a nuntakna sanga thupi zaw omlo hi. I gal khempeuh Pasian in hong dopih a, hong zawhpihsa vive hi.

spirituality, christian.explanation: Kha thu bek. Tapidawte leh Pasian kizopna banah pawlpi tawh kizopna hi. Kha thu bek cih ciangin leitung nate nawlkhin a Pasian thu sung bek ah lungkimna hi. Kha thu bek ngaihsutna cih ciangin thungetna, biakpiakna, phatna leh sepna cihte hi a, thudangte nawlkhinna hi. Khazih mi banga nuntakna hi.

submission to husband.explanation: Pasal ukna zuihna. Pasian tate leh tapidaw innkuan kimakaihna khat hi. Zi leh numei in pasal ukna a zuih ding hi. Zi in ama pasal sawl bangin gamta ding hi. Pianngei thu ah Greekte leh Latinte muhna kibanglo napi kihuang hi. Greekte muhna ah ousia pen substance/essence kici in a khiatna pianngei hi. Hypostasis pen person, mimal hi. Latinte muhna ah substantia pen substance / essence, pianngei hi in, persona pen person, mimal hi. Ousia leh substantia a kithuah ciangin Pasian pianngeite tawh kibang lian in, amaute: Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho, mimal thum kibatna kilangsak hi. theocentric.explanation: Pasian bulphuh. Na khempeuh ah a nungta Pasian leh a kammal tungah kingakna hi. Tapidaw nuntakna ah i kingakna ding leh i bulphuh ding Pasian leh a kammal bek om a, mipilte theihna, mihingte ngeina leh mi khat genkholhna tawh kalsuanna hilo hi. Pasian a bulphuh nuntakna bek mannei hi. Mihingte khuak tunga kingakna kiplo a, Pasian kammal tunga dinna bek kip hi.

theocentricity.explanation: Pasian tung bek ah kingakna. Pasian tung bek ah kingakna in a gilpen leh a thupi pen hi. Vai khempeuh ah Pasian deihna zui a, Pasian deihlohte pelh a, Pasian sawlna banga gamtatna hi. Mihingte tungah kingakna in milim biakna suak a, Pasian in ama tunga kingate lamsang hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna dingin mihingte in sep ding omlo a, Pasian in hong sepsaksa vive hi. Mawhneite in hotkhiatna ngahna dingin bangmah sem theilo hi. Pasian tungah upna lam ding hi. theological method.explanation: Pasian thugil sutzia. Laisiangtho leh Pasian thu pen thuk mahmah ahih manin ahi banga theih ding baihlo in eima updan leh hoihsak dan in kisut ciat hi. Pasian thugil sutna ah muhdan a tuamtuam om a, mihing a thupisak om hi, Arminianism; Pasian thupina a thupisak zong om hi, Calvinism; khuak ngaihsutna tunga kinga om in, liberalism; tuahkhak thute tunga kinga om in, Pentecostalism; sepna leh pawlpi thukhunte tunga kinga zong om in, Roman Catholicism; Thukham zuihna tunga kinga zong om hi, Seventh Day Adventists. Upna hangin Pasian hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna kingah hi, cih pen piangthakte upna phungpi leh thugil sutzia hi.

theology of hope.explanation: Lametna. Tapidaw upna laigil khempeuh hun nunung cianga hong piang ding thute tawh gawmkhawm a, lametna tawh nuntakna hi. Hih upna pen Jürgen Moltmann in mukhia in, tapidaw upna pen mailam thu ding hizaw hi, cih tawh khup hi.

theology of liberation.explanation: Suahtakna. Nenniamna thuakte suahtakna dinga Laisiangtho siksan a hilhna leh kipuahphatna hi. Gentheihna pan suahtakna dingin upna maan kisam hi. Upna hangin a suaktate ihi hi.

theology of nature.explanation: Nate omzia. A kimu thei leh kimu theilo nate in Pasian khutma leh Pasian piansak hi. Hih in natural theology tawh kilehbulh hi. Piansakna in Pasian khutma hi. Pasian theihna tawh na khempeuh piang hi.

theology of the blessed.explanation: Midikte omna. Vantung gam a tungte in thupha ngah hi. Leitung thute sangin vantung gam thu limci zaw leh zaknop zaw a, vantung ah na khempeuh kicing hi.

theology of the cross (theologia crucis).explanation: Singlamteh thu tunga kingakna. Luther in Pasian thu a sut ciangin singlamteh thu tawh pan masa hi. Singlamteh tunga thahna a thuak Zeisu hangin mawhna khempeuh mai in, Pasian hehpihna hangin dikna leh sianthona kingah a, Pasian innkuanpih kisuak hi. Singlamteh in Pasian itna leh hehpihna hong lak ahih manin mihing pilna leh khuak tungah kinga lo a, Pasian itna up leh muanna tawh kalsuan ding hi. Upna tawh dikna ngahte nungta ding hi ‘The Just by Faith Shall Live’ (Rom 1:17). Upna bek tawh, sepna kihello in, dikna kingah hi.

theology of the unregenerate.explanation: A piangthaklote. A piangthaklote in upna bek tawh Pasian ta suak ding hi. Pasian hehpihna tawh upna kingah in tua upna in dikna hong pia hi. A piangthaklote in gawtmun zuan ding hi.

theology proper.explanation: Pa Pasian. Pa, Tapa leh Khasiangtho sung pan Pa Pasian thu hi phadiak hi. Pasian pianngei leh Pasian vangliatna sutna hi. Mihingte theih theih dingin Pasian pen Pa bangin kimu in, Pa pen a lianpen bangin om hi.

theonomism.explanation: Pasian thupiak. Pasian in a ut peuhpeuh teeltuam in, na khempeuh a hoih in bawl hi. Pasian khial theilo hi. Pasian thupiak leh kammal khempeuh siangtho in manpha hi.

theopaschitism.explanation: Pasian khat sihna. John Maxentius hilhna tawh kizom a, hilhna maanlo khat hi in, ‘Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian a kici sunga khat kithatlum hi’.

theophany.explanation: Mi banga kilaakna. Thukhun Lui sungah Pasian pen khat veivei mihing leh vantungmi bangin kilang hi (Pian.16:7-13; Josh.5:13-15). Hih banga kilaakna pen Pasian kilaakna kici hi. Tuate pen Zeisu leitung ah mihing banga hong pianma a hong kilaakna zong kici thei hi (Pian.18; Tkte.6). Hih banga kilaakna pen hun khat ciangin bei hi.

theopneustos (inspiration of scripture).explanation: Pasian humop. Laisiangtho in Pasian humopna tawh kigelh hi. Pasian humop cih ciangin Pasian makaihna, Pasian lahna leh Pasian gelhsak bangin kigelh cihna hi. Pasian in Laisiangtho gelhte makaih ahih manin khialhna leh kitukkalhna omlo hi. Laisiangtho in tapidaw upna phungpi hi. Laisiangtho in Pasian maan theihna hong guan hi. Laisiangtho in a nunung pen Pasian kilaakna hi.

theopoiesis.explanation: Pasian banga sianthona. Pasian banga omna leh kingaihsutna hi. Sianthona in Pasian tawh kinaihna piangsak hi. Mi khat in Pasian a up ciangin Pasian kiang zuan in Pasian tawh kinaihtak in kalsuan thei hi.

true god.explanation: Pasian maan. Bangmah lo pan na khempeuh piangsak in, na khempeuh tungah ukna nei in, a mawhcip mihingte Satan khutsung leh gawtmun pan honkhia in, amah a umte tungah nuntak tawntungna pia a, mi khempeuh it in thupha pia a, amah a umte bittak in kem hi.

true knowledge.explanation: Theihna maan. Theihna maan i cih in Pasian maan theihna leh ei leh ei kitheihna hi. Laisiangtho tungtawn in theihna maan kingah hi. Theihna maan i ngah ciangin kipuahphatna piang hi. Mawhnei hihna kitheihna leh Pasian ta hihna kitheihna in theihna maan hi.

true salvation.explanation: Hotkhiatna maan. Pasian in Zeisu tawh mawhneite hong hotkhiat ciangin kha bek honkhialo in ci leh sa zong honkhia hi. Zeisu hotkhiatna a sangte in tawntung bitna ngah hi.

Pasian in mi a teel ciangin mailam ah hoih ding leh hoihlo ding cih a theihkhitsa ahih hangin tua tungtawn in teello in ama hoihsak bangin teel hi. Teeltuamna pen Pasian thupina kilatna hi. I hoihna leh siamna tungtawn in Pasian in hong teello in ama hoihsak bangin hong teel hi. Mihingte in Pasian teel leh teelloh thei theilo a, Pasian bek in teel hi. Mihingte in Pasian teello in Pasian in hong teel hi. Hih pen Calvin upna leh hilhna sungah a thupi mahmah khat hi. Pasian teeltuamte in hotkhiatna thu za a hong pianthakna dingin lungdamna thu genkhiat ding hi. Zakna panin upna piang hi. A zalote in um ngeilo ding hi.

wesleyanism.explanation: Wesley upna bulpi. John Wesley (1703-91) pen tuucing, missionary, theologian leh evangelist hi. Ama thute leh Arminius upna kihuang mahmah in Britain gamah kizel kawikawi a, Methodist pawlpi upna phungpi suak hi. Wesley pen Anglican pawlpi hi masa in, England pan USA ah lungdamna thu gen dinga a paina panin May 24, 1738 in Moraviante tawh a kimuhna leh Martin Luther laibute tungtawn in piangthak hi. Wesley in Reformedte upna sunga Pasian sehkholhna, predestination, nial in, Pasian in ama theihkholhna tawh kizui in teel hi, ci hi. John Calvin upna leh hilhna tawh a kilehbulh vive um hi.

word of god.explanation: Pasian kammal. Laisiangtho in Pasian kammal hi. Zeisu leh Pasian genkhiat thute hi. (1) Nam Thum Pawl Khat Pasian ah a nihnapa ahi Zeisu in mihing hong suak Pasian kammal hi. Zeisu, Pasian kammal, in a kimu theilo Pasian pianngeite hong lak hi (Jn.1:1,14,17). Pasian thugen khempeuh, Pasian in hih bangin gen hi ‘Thus saith the Lord’ cihte in na khempeuh a piangsakpa kammal hi (Late 33:6). Pasian thu pen ama mipawlte tungah thuhilhna leh Pasian deihna genna hi (Thkna.28:10-14). Mihingte zang a Pasian in a gelhkhiat Laisiangtho, bu 66, in a khial theilo leh vangliatna tawh kidim Pasian kammal hi (2Tim.3:16-17). Laisiangtho in Pasian kammal ahih manin vangliatna tawh kidim in mi khempeuh tungah ukna nei hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna dingin hih laibu ngahloh, simloh, theihloh, neihloh, uploh leh zuihloh phamawh hi. Pasian kammal sungah khialhna omlo hi. Laisiangtho sunga om laimal khempeuh leh laibu khempeuh in Pasian thu leh Pasian humop hi.

word of men.explanation: Mihingte kammal. Mihingte kammal sungah khialhna tampi om a, Pasian kammal sungah khialhna omlo hi. Leitung paute sungah Pasian pianziate sutna dingin a kicing pen leh a siangtho pen cih ding om tuanlo hi.
